ko.title: 9월 소비자물가지수(CPI) 보고서 발표 임박: 주거비, 식품, 에너지 가격에서 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: The next Consumer Price Index (CPI) report is one of the most closely followed economic releases of the year.
segments.tr: 다음 소비자물가지수(CPI) 보고서는 올해 가장 주목받는 경제 지표 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: With energy costs in focus, longer-term Treasury yields elevated and the Federal Reserve's next policy meeting approaching, the September reading could shape how markets and households think about interest rates in the months ahead.
segments.tr: 에너지 비용이 주목받고, 장기 국채 금리가 높은 수준을 유지하며, 연방준비제도의 다음 정책 회의가 다가옴에 따라, 이번 9월 물가 지표는 향후 몇 달간 시장과 가계가 금리에 대해 어떻게 생각할지에 큰 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: This guide explains what the report measures, which categories deserve the closest attention, and how price changes can show up in a typical household budget.
segments.tr: 이 가이드는 보고서가 측정하는 내용, 가장 주의 깊게 살펴봐야 할 항목, 그리고 가격 변동이 일반적인 가계 예산에 어떻게 나타날 수 있는지 설명합니다.

segments.src: It is general educational information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: 이는 일반적인 교육 정보일 뿐, 재정적 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## What the CPI Actually Measures
segments.tr: ## CPI가 실제로 측정하는 것

segments.src: The CPI, published by the U.S.
segments.tr: 미국

segments.src: Bureau of Labor Statistics, tracks how the prices of a broad basket of goods and services change over time.
segments.tr: 노동통계국에서 발표하는 CPI는 광범위한 상품 및 서비스 바구니의 가격이 시간이 지남에 따라 어떻게 변동하는지 추적합니다.

segments.src: That basket includes housing, food, transportation, medical care, apparel, recreation and more.
segments.tr: 해당 바구니에는 주거비, 식품, 교통, 의료, 의류, 여가 등이 포함됩니다.

segments.src: Two versions get the most attention:
segments.tr: 가장 주목받는 두 가지 버전은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **Headline CPI** covers all items, including food and energy.
segments.tr: - **헤드라인 CPI(Headline CPI)**는 식품과 에너지를 포함한 모든 품목을 다룹니다.

segments.src: - **Core CPI** excludes food and energy, which tend to swing from month to month. Many economists use it as a cleaner read on underlying inflation trends.
segments.tr: - **근원 CPI(Core CPI)**는 월별 변동성이 큰 식품과 에너지를 제외합니다. 많은 경제학자들은 기조적인 인플레이션 추세를 더 명확하게 파악하기 위해 이를 사용합니다.

segments.src: Both are reported as a monthly change and as a year-over-year change.
segments.tr: 두 지표 모두 전월 대비 변화율과 전년 동기 대비 변화율로 보고됩니다.

segments.src: Analysts often compare the actual numbers with the consensus forecast, since a surprise in either direction can move markets.
segments.tr: 어느 방향으로든 예상치 못한 결과가 나오면 시장을 움직일 수 있기 때문에, 분석가들은 종종 실제 수치를 시장 컨센서스 전망치와 비교합니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Fed Pays Close Attention
segments.tr: ## 연준이 면밀히 주시하는 이유

segments.src: The Federal Reserve has a dual mandate: stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: 미국 연방준비제도(Fed)는 물가 안정과 최대 고용이라는 이중 책무를 가지고 있습니다.

segments.src: When it sets its benchmark interest rate, it weighs inflation data against labor market conditions.
segments.tr: 기준금리를 설정할 때 연준은 인플레이션 데이터와 노동 시장 상황을 함께 저울질합니다.

segments.src: - If inflation cools in line with or faster than expected, policymakers may feel more comfortable easing policy.
segments.tr: - 인플레이션이 예상에 부합하거나 그보다 빠르게 둔화되면 정책 입안자들은 통화 정책 완화에 더 안도감을 느낄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - If inflation proves stubborn, the Fed may hold rates steady for longer, and some investors may reduce their expectations for rate cuts.
segments.tr: - 인플레이션이 끈질기게 유지될 경우 연준은 금리를 더 오랫동안 동결할 수 있으며, 일부 투자자는 금리 인하 기대를 낮출 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge is actually the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, but CPI arrives earlier and is widely used as a signal for what PCE may show.
segments.tr: 연준이 선호하는 인플레이션 지표는 사실 개인소비지출(PCE) 물가 지수이지만, CPI가 더 일찍 발표되기 때문에 PCE의 향방을 가늠하는 신호로 널리 사용됩니다.

segments.src: That is why a single CPI release can carry so much weight.
segments.tr: 단 한 번의 CPI 발표가 그토록 큰 무게를 갖는 이유가 바로 여기에 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The Rate Backdrop: Yields and Borrowing Costs
segments.tr: ## 금리 배경: 국채 금리와 차입 비용

segments.src: Longer-term Treasury yields influence borrowing costs across the economy, including mortgage rates, auto loans and business financing.
segments.tr: 장기 국채 금리는 모기지 금리, 자동차 대출, 기업 금융을 포함한 경제 전반의 차입 비용에 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: When yields rise, those costs often move up as well, even if the Fed has not changed its own policy rate.
segments.tr: 금리가 상승하면 연준이 자체 정책 금리를 변경하지 않았더라도 이러한 비용 역시 함께 상승하는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: Because yields reflect expectations about future inflation and future Fed decisions, a CPI report that changes those expectations can ripple quickly through bond markets.
segments.tr: 국채 금리는 미래 인플레이션과 연준의 향후 결정에 대한 기대를 반영하기 때문에, 이러한 기대를 바꾸는 CPI 보고서는 채권 시장을 통해 빠르게 파급될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: For households, that can mean changes in what it costs to finance a home, a car or a large purchase.
segments.tr: 가계의 입장에서 이는 주택, 자동차 또는 고가품을 구입하기 위해 자금을 조달하는 비용의 변화를 의미할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Category One: Shelter
segments.tr: ## 첫 번째 카테고리: 주거비

segments.src: Shelter, which includes rent and owners' equivalent rent, is the largest single component of the CPI.
segments.tr: 임대료와 자가거주자 추정임대료를 포함하는 주거비는 CPI에서 단일 품목으로는 비중이 가장 큽니다.

segments.src: Because it carries so much weight, even small monthly changes can have a noticeable effect on the overall number.
segments.tr: 비중이 매우 크기 때문에 작은 월간 변동만으로도 전체 수치에 눈에 띄는 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: 주목해야 할 점:

segments.src: - **Rent and owners' equivalent rent.** These measures often move gradually, since they reflect leases that renew over time. A steady cooling trend would be a welcome sign for inflation watchers.
segments.tr: - **임대료 및 자가거주자 추정임대료.** 이 지표들은 시간에 걸쳐 갱신되는 임대 계약을 반영하기 때문에 보통 점진적으로 움직입니다. 꾸준한 둔화 추세는 인플레이션 관찰자들에게 반가운 신호가 될 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Lodging away from home.** Hotel prices can be volatile and may add noise to the monthly figure.
segments.tr: - **자가 숙박 외 시설.** 호텔 가격은 변동성이 클 수 있으며 월간 수치에 노이즈를 더할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: **Household impact:** For renters, shelter costs are often the biggest line in the budget.
segments.tr: **가계에 미치는 영향:** 임차인의 경우 주거비는 대개 예산에서 가장 큰 항목을 차지합니다.

segments.src: Lease renewals, rather than the monthly CPI release, are usually what change your actual rent, but the broader trend can signal what to expect.
segments.tr: 실제 임대료를 바꾸는 것은 월간 CPI 발표라기보다는 대개 임대차 계약 갱신이지만, 광범위한 추세를 통해 무엇을 예상해야 할지 알 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Category Two: Food
segments.tr: ## 두 번째 카테고리: 식품

segments.src: Food prices are divided into two parts:
segments.tr: 식품 가격은 두 가지로 나뉩니다:

segments.src: - **Food at home**, meaning groceries.
segments.tr: - **가정 내 식품**, 즉 식료품.

segments.src: - **Food away from home**, meaning restaurants and takeout.
segments.tr: - **외식**, 즉 식당 및 테이크아웃.

segments.src: Grocery prices can respond to weather, supply chain conditions, transportation costs and global commodity markets.
segments.tr: 식료품 가격은 날씨, 공급망 상황, 운송 비용, 글로벌 원자재 시장의 영향을 받을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Restaurant prices tend to be stickier because they reflect labor and rent costs that do not change quickly.
segments.tr: 식당 가격은 쉽게 변하지 않는 노동 및 임대료 비용을 반영하기 때문에 상대적으로 경직되어 있는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: **Household impact:** Food is a frequent purchase, so price changes are felt quickly.
segments.tr: **가계에 미치는 영향:** 식품은 빈번하게 구매하는 품목이므로 가격 변화를 빠르게 체감하게 됩니다.

segments.src: Many consumers say grocery costs shape their view of the economy more than any headline statistic.
segments.tr: 많은 소비자는 식료품 비용이 그 어떤 헤드라인 통계보다 경제에 대한 시각을 형성하는 데 큰 영향을 미친다고 말합니다.

segments.src: ## Category Three: Energy
segments.tr: ## 세 번째 카테고리: 에너지

segments.src: Energy includes gasoline, electricity, natural gas and fuel oil.
segments.tr: 에너지에는 휘발유, 전기, 천연가스, 연료유가 포함됩니다.

segments.src: It is typically the most volatile part of the CPI.
segments.tr: 이는 일반적으로 CPI에서 가장 변동성이 큰 부분입니다.

segments.src: Diesel costs deserve attention because diesel powers trucks, freight and farm equipment, so higher fuel costs can eventually feed into the prices of many goods.
segments.tr: 디젤은 트럭, 화물 운송, 농기계의 동력으로 사용되기 때문에 디젤 비용에 주의를 기울여야 하며, 연료 비용 상승은 결국 많은 상품의 가격 상승으로 이어질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: 주목해야 할 점:

segments.src: - **Gasoline.** Often the biggest swing factor in the headline number from month to month.
segments.tr: - **휘발유.** 월별 헤드라인 수치에서 가장 큰 변동 요인인 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: - **Utilities.** Electricity and natural gas bills can shift with seasonal demand and fuel costs.
segments.tr: - **공공요금.** 전기 및 천연가스 고지서는 계절적 수요와 연료 비용에 따라 달라질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Pass-through effects.** Higher transportation costs may show up later in goods prices, which is why analysts look beyond the energy line itself.
segments.tr: - **파급 효과.** 운송 비용 상승이 나중에 상품 가격에 반영될 수 있으며, 이것이 분석가들이 에너지 품목 그 자체만 보지 않는 이유입니다.

segments.src: **Household impact:** Fuel and utility costs affect commuters, families who drive long distances and anyone with a large heating or cooling bill.
segments.tr: **가계에 미치는 영향:** 연료 및 공공요금 비용은 통근자, 장거리를 운전하는 가족, 난방이나 냉방 비용이 많이 드는 모든 사람에게 영향을 줍니다.

segments.src: ## Other Areas Worth a Look
segments.tr: ## 살펴볼 만한 기타 분야

segments.src: Beyond the big three, analysts will also check:
segments.tr: 핵심 3대 분야 외에도 분석가들은 다음을 확인할 것입니다:

segments.src: - **Core goods**, such as vehicles, furniture and apparel.
segments.tr: - 차량, 가구, 의류와 같은 **근원 상품**.

segments.src: - **Services excluding shelter**, including insurance, medical care and transportation services, which are closely tied to wages.
segments.tr: - 임대료를 제외한 **서비스** (보험, 의료, 교통 서비스 등 포함), 이는 임금과 긴밀하게 연관되어 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Used vehicle and auto insurance prices**, which have been notable sources of volatility in recent years.
segments.tr: - 최근 몇 년간 주목할 만한 변동성의 원인이 되어온 **중고차 및 자동차 보험 가격**.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Report Without Overreacting
segments.tr: ## 과민반응하지 않고 보고서를 읽는 방법

segments.src: A single month of data rarely tells the full story.
segments.tr: 단 한 달치의 데이터가 모든 것을 말해주지는 않습니다.

segments.src: A few habits can help:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 습관이 도움이 될 수 있습니다:

segments.src: 1. **Compare to expectations.** Markets react to surprises, not to the number alone.
segments.tr: 1. **예상치와 비교하기.** 시장은 수치 그 자체보다는 예상치 못한 결과(서프라이즈)에 반응합니다.

segments.src: 2. **Look at the trend.** Three- and six-month changes can smooth out one-off swings.
segments.tr: 2. **추세 살펴보기.** 3개월 및 6개월 변화율은 일회성 등락을 완만하게 만들어 줍니다.

segments.src: 3. **Separate headline from core.** A jump driven by energy may mean something different than a jump in services.
segments.tr: 3. **헤드라인과 근원 분리하기.** 에너지로 인한 급등은 서비스 부문의 급등과는 다른 의미를 가질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Remember revisions and seasonal adjustments.** Data can be revised, and seasonal factors can distort individual months.
segments.tr: 4. **수정치와 계절 조정 감안하기.** 데이터는 수정될 수 있으며, 계절적 요인으로 인해 개별 월의 수치가 왜곡될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Practical Takeaways for Your Budget
segments.tr: ## 예산을 위한 실용적인 시사점

segments.src: Whatever the report shows, a few general steps can help you stay prepared:
segments.tr: 보고서 결과가 어떻든, 몇 가지 일반적인 조치를 통해 준비를 유지할 수 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Review your recurring expenses.** Rent or mortgage, utilities, groceries, transportation and insurance are the categories most affected by price changes.
segments.tr: - **정기 지출 검토하기.** 임대료 또는 모기지, 공공요금, 식료품, 교통비, 보험은 가격 변동의 영향을 가장 많이 받는 카테고리입니다.

segments.src: - **Check variable-rate debt.** Credit cards and some loans can be sensitive to interest rate expectations.
segments.tr: - **변동금리 부채 점검하기.** 신용카드와 일부 대출은 금리 기대치에 민감할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Compare savings options.** If rates stay higher for longer, savings accounts and certificates of deposit may continue to offer competitive yields, though terms vary by institution.
segments.tr: - **저축 상품 비교하기.** 금리가 더 오랫동안 높은 수준을 유지한다면, 기관별로 조건은 다르겠지만 예금 계좌와 양도성예금증서(CD)는 계속해서 경쟁력 있는 수익률을 제공할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Build flexibility.** A small cushion for unexpected price increases can make a month-to-month budget easier to manage.
segments.tr: - **유연성 확보하기.** 예상치 못한 물가 상승에 대비한 약간의 여유 자금은 월별 예산을 더 관리하기 쉽게 만들어 줍니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The September CPI report will offer fresh evidence on whether inflation is continuing to cool or proving more persistent.
segments.tr: 9월 CPI 보고서는 인플레이션이 계속 둔화하고 있는지, 아니면 더 지속적인 성향을 보이고 있는지에 대한 새로운 증거를 제공할 것입니다.

segments.src: Shelter, food and energy are the categories most likely to shape both the headline number and the way households experience prices day to day.
segments.tr: 주거비, 식품, 에너지는 헤드라인 수치와 가계가 일상에서 체감하는 물가 모두에 가장 큰 영향을 미칠 가능성이 높은 카테고리입니다.

segments.src: The reading could influence expectations for the Fed's next move, but the central bank will also weigh employment data and other indicators before making a decision.
segments.tr: 이번 물가 지표는 연준의 다음 행보에 대한 기대에 영향을 미칠 수 있지만, 중앙은행은 결정을 내리기 전에 고용 데이터 및 기타 지표도 함께 저울질할 것입니다.

segments.src: For the latest figures, consult the Bureau of Labor Statistics at bls.gov and the Federal Reserve at federalreserve.gov.
segments.tr: 최신 수치를 확인하려면 bls.gov의 미국 노동통계국과 federalreserve.gov의 연방준비제도를 참고하세요.

zh.title: 九月CPI报告发布在即：关注住房、食品和能源价格

segments.src: The next Consumer Price Index (CPI) report is one of the most closely followed economic releases of the year.
segments.tr: 下一份消费者价格指数（CPI）报告是年度最受关注的经济数据发布之一。

segments.src: With energy costs in focus, longer-term Treasury yields elevated and the Federal Reserve's next policy meeting approaching, the September reading could shape how markets and households think about interest rates in the months ahead.
segments.tr: 随着能源成本成为焦点、长期国债收益率走高以及美联储下一次政策会议临近，九月份的数据可能会影响市场和家庭对未来几个月利率走势的看法。

segments.src: This guide explains what the report measures, which categories deserve the closest attention, and how price changes can show up in a typical household budget.
segments.tr: 本指南将解释该报告的衡量内容、哪些类别最值得关注，以及价格变化如何体现在典型的家庭预算中。

segments.src: It is general educational information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: 本文仅供一般性教育参考，不构成财务建议。

segments.src: ## What the CPI Actually Measures
segments.tr: ## CPI 实际衡量什么

segments.src: The CPI, published by the U.S.
segments.tr: CPI 由美国

segments.src: Bureau of Labor Statistics, tracks how the prices of a broad basket of goods and services change over time.
segments.tr: 劳工统计局发布，旨在追踪一篮子广泛商品和服务的价格随时间的变化情况。

segments.src: That basket includes housing, food, transportation, medical care, apparel, recreation and more.
segments.tr: 这一篮子商品包括住房、食品、交通、医疗保健、服装、娱乐等。

segments.src: Two versions get the most attention:
segments.tr: 其中两个版本最受关注：

segments.src: - **Headline CPI** covers all items, including food and energy.
segments.tr: - **整体 CPI** 涵盖所有项目，包括食品和能源。

segments.src: - **Core CPI** excludes food and energy, which tend to swing from month to month. Many economists use it as a cleaner read on underlying inflation trends.
segments.tr: - **核心 CPI** 剔除了波动较大的食品和能源。许多经济学家将其视为衡量潜在通胀趋势的更清晰指标。

segments.src: Both are reported as a monthly change and as a year-over-year change.
segments.tr: 两者均以月度变化和同比变化的形式报告。

segments.src: Analysts often compare the actual numbers with the consensus forecast, since a surprise in either direction can move markets.
segments.tr: 分析师通常会将实际数据与市场共识预测进行比较，因为任何方向的意外数据都可能引发市场波动。

segments.src: ## Why the Fed Pays Close Attention
segments.tr: ## 为什么美联储密切关注

segments.src: The Federal Reserve has a dual mandate: stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: 美联储肩负双重使命：保持物价稳定和实现充分就业。

segments.src: When it sets its benchmark interest rate, it weighs inflation data against labor market conditions.
segments.tr: 在设定基准利率时，它会权衡通胀数据与劳动力市场状况。

segments.src: - If inflation cools in line with or faster than expected, policymakers may feel more comfortable easing policy.
segments.tr: - 如果通胀降温速度符合或快于预期，政策制定者可能会更放心地放松政策。

segments.src: - If inflation proves stubborn, the Fed may hold rates steady for longer, and some investors may reduce their expectations for rate cuts.
segments.tr: - 如果通胀表现顽固，美联储可能会在更长时间内维持利率不变，一些投资者可能会降低对降息的预期。

segments.src: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge is actually the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, but CPI arrives earlier and is widely used as a signal for what PCE may show.
segments.tr: 美联储首选的通胀指标实际上是个人消费支出（PCE）价格指数，但 CPI 发布时间更早，被广泛用作预测 PCE 走势的信号。

segments.src: That is why a single CPI release can carry so much weight.
segments.tr: 这就是为什么单次 CPI 发布会产生如此大的影响。

segments.src: ## The Rate Backdrop: Yields and Borrowing Costs
segments.tr: ## 利率背景：收益率与借贷成本

segments.src: Longer-term Treasury yields influence borrowing costs across the economy, including mortgage rates, auto loans and business financing.
segments.tr: 长期国债收益率影响整个经济体的借贷成本，包括抵押贷款利率、汽车贷款和商业融资。

segments.src: When yields rise, those costs often move up as well, even if the Fed has not changed its own policy rate.
segments.tr: 当收益率上升时，即使美联储没有改变其政策利率，这些成本通常也会随之上升。

segments.src: Because yields reflect expectations about future inflation and future Fed decisions, a CPI report that changes those expectations can ripple quickly through bond markets.
segments.tr: 由于收益率反映了对未来通胀和美联储未来决策的预期，一份改变这些预期的 CPI 报告可能会迅速波及债券市场。

segments.src: For households, that can mean changes in what it costs to finance a home, a car or a large purchase.
segments.tr: 对于家庭而言，这意味着为住房、汽车或大额消费融资的成本可能会发生变化。

segments.src: ## Category One: Shelter
segments.tr: ## 第一类：住房

segments.src: Shelter, which includes rent and owners' equivalent rent, is the largest single component of the CPI.
segments.tr: 住房（包括租金和业主等价租金）是 CPI 中占比最大的单一组成部分。

segments.src: Because it carries so much weight, even small monthly changes can have a noticeable effect on the overall number.
segments.tr: 由于其权重很大，即使是微小的月度变化也会对整体数据产生显著影响。

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: 关注点：

segments.src: - **Rent and owners' equivalent rent.** These measures often move gradually, since they reflect leases that renew over time. A steady cooling trend would be a welcome sign for inflation watchers.
segments.tr: - **租金和业主等价租金。** 这些指标通常变化缓慢，因为它们反映的是随时间推移而续签的租约。持续的降温趋势对通胀观察者来说将是一个受欢迎的信号。

segments.src: - **Lodging away from home.** Hotel prices can be volatile and may add noise to the monthly figure.
segments.tr: - **外宿住宿。** 酒店价格可能波动较大，可能会给月度数据带来干扰。

segments.src: **Household impact:** For renters, shelter costs are often the biggest line in the budget.
segments.tr: **对家庭的影响：** 对于租房者来说，住房成本通常是预算中最大的一笔支出。

segments.src: Lease renewals, rather than the monthly CPI release, are usually what change your actual rent, but the broader trend can signal what to expect.
segments.tr: 租约续签（而非每月的 CPI 发布）通常才是改变你实际租金的原因，但更广泛的趋势可以预示未来的预期。

segments.src: ## Category Two: Food
segments.tr: ## 第二类：食品

segments.src: Food prices are divided into two parts:
segments.tr: 食品价格分为两部分：

segments.src: - **Food at home**, meaning groceries.
segments.tr: - **家庭食品**，即杂货。

segments.src: - **Food away from home**, meaning restaurants and takeout.
segments.tr: - **外出就餐食品**，即餐厅和外卖。

segments.src: Grocery prices can respond to weather, supply chain conditions, transportation costs and global commodity markets.
segments.tr: 杂货价格可能受到天气、供应链状况、运输成本和全球大宗商品市场的影响。

segments.src: Restaurant prices tend to be stickier because they reflect labor and rent costs that do not change quickly.
segments.tr: 餐厅价格往往更具粘性，因为它们反映了不会迅速变化的劳动力和租金成本。

segments.src: **Household impact:** Food is a frequent purchase, so price changes are felt quickly.
segments.tr: **对家庭的影响：** 食品是高频消费品，因此价格变化感受非常直接。

segments.src: Many consumers say grocery costs shape their view of the economy more than any headline statistic.
segments.tr: 许多消费者表示，杂货成本比任何头条统计数据更能影响他们对经济的看法。

segments.src: ## Category Three: Energy
segments.tr: ## 第三类：能源

segments.src: Energy includes gasoline, electricity, natural gas and fuel oil.
segments.tr: 能源包括汽油、电力、天然气和燃料油。

segments.src: It is typically the most volatile part of the CPI.
segments.tr: 它通常是 CPI 中波动最大的部分。

segments.src: Diesel costs deserve attention because diesel powers trucks, freight and farm equipment, so higher fuel costs can eventually feed into the prices of many goods.
segments.tr: 柴油成本值得关注，因为柴油为卡车、货运和农用设备提供动力，因此燃料成本上升最终可能会传导至许多商品的价格中。

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: 关注点：

segments.src: - **Gasoline.** Often the biggest swing factor in the headline number from month to month.
segments.tr: - **汽油。** 通常是导致月度整体数据波动的最大因素。

segments.src: - **Utilities.** Electricity and natural gas bills can shift with seasonal demand and fuel costs.
segments.tr: - **公用事业。** 电费和天然气账单可能会随着季节性需求和燃料成本而波动。

segments.src: - **Pass-through effects.** Higher transportation costs may show up later in goods prices, which is why analysts look beyond the energy line itself.
segments.tr: - **传导效应。** 更高的运输成本可能会在稍后体现在商品价格中，这就是为什么分析师不仅关注能源本身的原因。

segments.src: **Household impact:** Fuel and utility costs affect commuters, families who drive long distances and anyone with a large heating or cooling bill.
segments.tr: **对家庭的影响：** 燃料和公用事业成本会影响通勤者、长途驾驶的家庭以及任何有高额供暖或制冷账单的人。

segments.src: ## Other Areas Worth a Look
segments.tr: ## 其他值得关注的领域

segments.src: Beyond the big three, analysts will also check:
segments.tr: 除了这三大类之外，分析师还将检查：

segments.src: - **Core goods**, such as vehicles, furniture and apparel.
segments.tr: - **核心商品**，如汽车、家具和服装。

segments.src: - **Services excluding shelter**, including insurance, medical care and transportation services, which are closely tied to wages.
segments.tr: - **除住房外的服务**，包括保险、医疗保健和运输服务，这些与工资密切相关。

segments.src: - **Used vehicle and auto insurance prices**, which have been notable sources of volatility in recent years.
segments.tr: - **二手车和汽车保险价格**，近年来一直是波动的重要来源。

segments.src: ## How to Read the Report Without Overreacting
segments.tr: ## 如何解读报告而不反应过度

segments.src: A single month of data rarely tells the full story.
segments.tr: 单月数据很少能说明全部情况。

segments.src: A few habits can help:
segments.tr: 养成以下几个习惯会有所帮助：

segments.src: 1. **Compare to expectations.** Markets react to surprises, not to the number alone.
segments.tr: 1. **与预期进行比较。** 市场对意外情况做出反应，而不是仅仅对数字本身。

segments.src: 2. **Look at the trend.** Three- and six-month changes can smooth out one-off swings.
segments.tr: 2. **观察趋势。** 三个月和六个月的变化可以平滑一次性的波动。

segments.src: 3. **Separate headline from core.** A jump driven by energy may mean something different than a jump in services.
segments.tr: 3. **区分整体与核心。** 由能源驱动的跳升可能与服务业的跳升意义不同。

segments.src: 4. **Remember revisions and seasonal adjustments.** Data can be revised, and seasonal factors can distort individual months.
segments.tr: 4. **记住修正和季节性调整。** 数据可能会被修正，季节性因素可能会扭曲单个月份的数据。

segments.src: ## Practical Takeaways for Your Budget
segments.tr: ## 对你预算的实际建议

segments.src: Whatever the report shows, a few general steps can help you stay prepared:
segments.tr: 无论报告显示什么，采取以下几个通用步骤可以帮助你保持准备状态：

segments.src: - **Review your recurring expenses.** Rent or mortgage, utilities, groceries, transportation and insurance are the categories most affected by price changes.
segments.tr: - **审查你的经常性支出。** 租金或抵押贷款、公用事业、杂货、交通和保险是受价格变化影响最大的类别。

segments.src: - **Check variable-rate debt.** Credit cards and some loans can be sensitive to interest rate expectations.
segments.tr: - **检查浮动利率债务。** 信用卡和某些贷款可能对利率预期敏感。

segments.src: - **Compare savings options.** If rates stay higher for longer, savings accounts and certificates of deposit may continue to offer competitive yields, though terms vary by institution.
segments.tr: - **比较储蓄选择。** 如果利率在更长时间内保持高位，储蓄账户和定期存单可能继续提供具有竞争力的收益率，尽管条款因机构而异。

segments.src: - **Build flexibility.** A small cushion for unexpected price increases can make a month-to-month budget easier to manage.
segments.tr: - **建立灵活性。** 为意外的价格上涨留出一点缓冲空间，可以使月度预算更容易管理。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: The September CPI report will offer fresh evidence on whether inflation is continuing to cool or proving more persistent.
segments.tr: 九月份的 CPI 报告将提供新的证据，表明通胀是继续降温还是表现得更为顽固。

segments.src: Shelter, food and energy are the categories most likely to shape both the headline number and the way households experience prices day to day.
segments.tr: 住房、食品和能源是最有可能影响整体数据以及家庭日常价格感受的类别。

segments.src: The reading could influence expectations for the Fed's next move, but the central bank will also weigh employment data and other indicators before making a decision.
segments.tr: 该数据可能会影响对美联储下一步行动的预期，但央行在做出决定前也会权衡就业数据和其他指标。

segments.src: For the latest figures, consult the Bureau of Labor Statistics at bls.gov and the Federal Reserve at federalreserve.gov.
segments.tr: 获取最新数据，请查阅劳工统计局网站 bls.gov 和美联储网站 federalreserve.gov。

segments.src: ## What the CPI Actually Measures
segments.tr: ## सीपीआई (CPI) वास्तव में क्या मापता है

segments.src: The CPI, published by the U.S.
segments.tr: सीपीआई, जिसे अमेरिकी

segments.src: Bureau of Labor Statistics, tracks how the prices of a broad basket of goods and services change over time.
segments.tr: श्रम सांख्यिकी ब्यूरो (Bureau of Labor Statistics) द्वारा प्रकाशित किया जाता है, यह ट्रैक करता है कि समय के साथ वस्तुओं और सेवाओं की एक विस्तृत टोकरी की कीमतें कैसे बदलती हैं।

segments.tr: उस टोकरी में आवास, भोजन, परिवहन, चिकित्सा देखभाल, परिधान, मनोरंजन और बहुत कुछ शामिल हैं।

segments.src: Two versions get the most attention:
segments.tr: दो संस्करणों पर सबसे अधिक ध्यान दिया जाता है:

segments.src: - **Headline CPI** covers all items, including food and energy.
segments.tr: - **हेडलाइन सीपीआई (Headline CPI)** में भोजन और ऊर्जा सहित सभी वस्तुएं शामिल हैं।

segments.src: - **Core CPI** excludes food and energy, which tend to swing from month to month. Many economists use it as a cleaner read on underlying inflation trends.
segments.tr: - **कोर सीपीआई (Core CPI)** में भोजन और ऊर्जा को बाहर रखा गया है, जो महीने-दर-महीने बदलते रहते हैं। कई अर्थशास्त्री इसका उपयोग अंतर्निहित मुद्रास्फीति के रुझानों को स्पष्ट रूप से पढ़ने के लिए करते हैं।

segments.src: Both are reported as a monthly change and as a year-over-year change.
segments.tr: दोनों को मासिक परिवर्तन और साल-दर-साल परिवर्तन के रूप में रिपोर्ट किया जाता है।

segments.src: Analysts often compare the actual numbers with the consensus forecast, since a surprise in either direction can move markets.
segments.tr: विश्लेषक अक्सर वास्तविक आंकड़ों की तुलना आम सहमति के पूर्वानुमान से करते हैं, क्योंकि किसी भी दिशा में आश्चर्य बाजारों को हिला सकता है।

segments.src: ## Why the Fed Pays Close Attention
segments.tr: ## फेडरल रिजर्व इतना ध्यान क्यों देता है

segments.src: The Federal Reserve has a dual mandate: stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: फेडरल रिजर्व का दोहरा जनादेश है: स्थिर कीमतें और अधिकतम रोजगार।

segments.src: When it sets its benchmark interest rate, it weighs inflation data against labor market conditions.
segments.tr: जब वह अपनी बेंचमार्क ब्याज दर निर्धारित करता है, तो वह श्रम बाजार की स्थितियों के मुकाबले मुद्रास्फीति के आंकड़ों को तौलता है।

segments.src: - If inflation cools in line with or faster than expected, policymakers may feel more comfortable easing policy.
segments.tr: - यदि मुद्रास्फीति उम्मीद के अनुरूप या उससे तेजी से ठंडी होती है, तो नीति निर्माता नीति को आसान बनाने में अधिक सहज महसूस कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: - If inflation proves stubborn, the Fed may hold rates steady for longer, and some investors may reduce their expectations for rate cuts.
segments.tr: - यदि मुद्रास्फीति जिद्दी बनी रहती है, तो फेड दरों को लंबे समय तक स्थिर रख सकता है, और कुछ निवेशक दर में कटौती की अपनी उम्मीदों को कम कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge is actually the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, but CPI arrives earlier and is widely used as a signal for what PCE may show.
segments.tr: फेड का पसंदीदा मुद्रास्फीति गेज वास्तव में व्यक्तिगत उपभोग व्यय (PCE) मूल्य सूचकांक है, लेकिन सीपीआई पहले आता है और व्यापक रूप से इस बात के संकेत के रूप में उपयोग किया जाता है कि पीसीई (PCE) क्या दिखा सकता है।

segments.src: That is why a single CPI release can carry so much weight.
segments.tr: यही कारण है कि एक एकल सीपीआई रिलीज इतना अधिक महत्व रखती है।

segments.src: ## The Rate Backdrop: Yields and Borrowing Costs
segments.tr: ## दर की पृष्ठभूमि: यील्ड और उधार लेने की लागत

segments.src: Longer-term Treasury yields influence borrowing costs across the economy, including mortgage rates, auto loans and business financing.
segments.tr: लंबी अवधि की ट्रेजरी यील्ड पूरी अर्थव्यवस्था में उधार लेने की लागत को प्रभावित करती है, जिसमें बंधक दरें (mortgage rates), ऑटो ऋण और व्यावसायिक वित्तपोषण शामिल हैं।

segments.src: When yields rise, those costs often move up as well, even if the Fed has not changed its own policy rate.
segments.tr: जब यील्ड बढ़ती है, तो वे लागतें भी अक्सर बढ़ जाती हैं, भले ही फेड ने अपनी नीति दर में बदलाव न किया हो।

segments.src: Because yields reflect expectations about future inflation and future Fed decisions, a CPI report that changes those expectations can ripple quickly through bond markets.
segments.tr: चूंकि यील्ड भविष्य की मुद्रास्फीति और भविष्य के फेड निर्णयों के बारे में उम्मीदों को दर्शाती है, इसलिए एक सीपीआई रिपोर्ट जो उन उम्मीदों को बदलती है, वह बॉन्ड बाजारों में तेजी से फैल सकती है।

segments.src: For households, that can mean changes in what it costs to finance a home, a car or a large purchase.
segments.tr: परिवारों के लिए, इसका मतलब घर, कार या बड़ी खरीदारी के वित्तपोषण की लागत में बदलाव हो सकता है।

segments.src: ## Category One: Shelter
segments.tr: ## श्रेणी एक: आवास (Shelter)

segments.src: Shelter, which includes rent and owners' equivalent rent, is the largest single component of the CPI.
segments.tr: आवास, जिसमें किराया और मालिकों का समतुल्य किराया शामिल है, सीपीआई का सबसे बड़ा एकल घटक है।

segments.src: Because it carries so much weight, even small monthly changes can have a noticeable effect on the overall number.
segments.tr: चूंकि इसका वजन इतना अधिक है, इसलिए छोटे मासिक बदलावों का भी कुल संख्या पर ध्यान देने योग्य प्रभाव पड़ सकता है।

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: क्या देखना है:

segments.src: - **Rent and owners' equivalent rent.** These measures often move gradually, since they reflect leases that renew over time. A steady cooling trend would be a welcome sign for inflation watchers.
segments.tr: - **किराया और मालिकों का समतुल्य किराया।** ये उपाय अक्सर धीरे-धीरे चलते हैं, क्योंकि वे उन पट्टों (leases) को दर्शाते हैं जो समय के साथ नवीनीकृत होते हैं। एक स्थिर ठंडा रुझान मुद्रास्फीति पर नजर रखने वालों के लिए एक स्वागत योग्य संकेत होगा।

segments.src: - **Lodging away from home.** Hotel prices can be volatile and may add noise to the monthly figure.
segments.tr: - **घर से दूर आवास।** होटल की कीमतें अस्थिर हो सकती हैं और मासिक आंकड़े में शोर जोड़ सकती हैं।

segments.src: **Household impact:** For renters, shelter costs are often the biggest line in the budget.
segments.tr: **घरेलू प्रभाव:** किराएदारों के लिए, आवास लागत अक्सर बजट में सबसे बड़ी पंक्ति होती है।

segments.src: Lease renewals, rather than the monthly CPI release, are usually what change your actual rent, but the broader trend can signal what to expect.
segments.tr: पट्टा नवीनीकरण, न कि मासिक सीपीआई रिलीज, आमतौर पर वह होता है जो आपके वास्तविक किराए को बदलता है, लेकिन व्यापक रुझान यह संकेत दे सकता है कि क्या उम्मीद की जाए।

segments.src: ## Category Two: Food
segments.tr: ## श्रेणी दो: भोजन

segments.src: Food prices are divided into two parts:
segments.tr: खाद्य कीमतों को दो भागों में विभाजित किया गया है:

segments.src: - **Food at home**, meaning groceries.
segments.tr: - **घर पर भोजन**, जिसका अर्थ है किराने का सामान।

segments.src: - **Food away from home**, meaning restaurants and takeout.
segments.tr: - **घर से बाहर भोजन**, जिसका अर्थ है रेस्तरां और टेकआउट।

segments.src: Grocery prices can respond to weather, supply chain conditions, transportation costs and global commodity markets.
segments.tr: किराने की कीमतें मौसम, आपूर्ति श्रृंखला की स्थिति, परिवहन लागत और वैश्विक कमोडिटी बाजारों के प्रति प्रतिक्रिया कर सकती हैं।

segments.src: Restaurant prices tend to be stickier because they reflect labor and rent costs that do not change quickly.
segments.tr: रेस्तरां की कीमतें अधिक स्थिर होती हैं क्योंकि वे श्रम और किराए की लागत को दर्शाती हैं जो जल्दी नहीं बदलती हैं।

segments.src: **Household impact:** Food is a frequent purchase, so price changes are felt quickly.
segments.tr: **घरेलू प्रभाव:** भोजन एक बार-बार की जाने वाली खरीदारी है, इसलिए कीमतों में बदलाव जल्दी महसूस किए जाते हैं।

segments.src: Many consumers say grocery costs shape their view of the economy more than any headline statistic.
segments.tr: कई उपभोक्ता कहते हैं कि किराने की लागत अर्थव्यवस्था के बारे में उनके दृष्टिकोण को किसी भी हेडलाइन आंकड़े से अधिक आकार देती है।

segments.src: ## Category Three: Energy
segments.tr: ## श्रेणी तीन: ऊर्जा

segments.src: Energy includes gasoline, electricity, natural gas and fuel oil.
segments.tr: ऊर्जा में गैसोलीन, बिजली, प्राकृतिक गैस और ईंधन तेल शामिल हैं।

segments.src: It is typically the most volatile part of the CPI.
segments.tr: यह आमतौर पर सीपीआई का सबसे अस्थिर हिस्सा होता है।

segments.src: Diesel costs deserve attention because diesel powers trucks, freight and farm equipment, so higher fuel costs can eventually feed into the prices of many goods.
segments.tr: डीजल लागत पर ध्यान देने की आवश्यकता है क्योंकि डीजल ट्रकों, माल ढुलाई और कृषि उपकरणों को शक्ति देता है, इसलिए उच्च ईंधन लागत अंततः कई वस्तुओं की कीमतों में शामिल हो सकती है।

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: क्या देखना है:

segments.src: - **Gasoline.** Often the biggest swing factor in the headline number from month to month.
segments.tr: - **गैसोलीन।** अक्सर महीने-दर-महीने हेडलाइन संख्या में सबसे बड़ा स्विंग कारक।

segments.src: - **Utilities.** Electricity and natural gas bills can shift with seasonal demand and fuel costs.
segments.tr: - **उपयोगिताएँ (Utilities)।** बिजली और प्राकृतिक गैस के बिल मौसमी मांग और ईंधन लागत के साथ बदल सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Pass-through effects.** Higher transportation costs may show up later in goods prices, which is why analysts look beyond the energy line itself.
segments.tr: - **पास-थ्रू प्रभाव।** उच्च परिवहन लागत बाद में वस्तुओं की कीमतों में दिखाई दे सकती है, यही कारण है कि विश्लेषक ऊर्जा लाइन से परे देखते हैं।

segments.src: **Household impact:** Fuel and utility costs affect commuters, families who drive long distances and anyone with a large heating or cooling bill.
segments.tr: **घरेलू प्रभाव:** ईंधन और उपयोगिता लागत यात्रियों, लंबी दूरी तक गाड़ी चलाने वाले परिवारों और बड़े हीटिंग या कूलिंग बिल वाले किसी भी व्यक्ति को प्रभावित करती है।

segments.src: ## Other Areas Worth a Look
segments.tr: ## अन्य क्षेत्र जिन पर एक नज़र डालने लायक है

segments.src: Beyond the big three, analysts will also check:
segments.tr: बड़ी तीन श्रेणियों से परे, विश्लेषक यह भी जांचेंगे:

segments.src: - **Core goods**, such as vehicles, furniture and apparel.
segments.tr: - **कोर सामान**, जैसे वाहन, फर्नीचर और परिधान।

segments.src: - **Services excluding shelter**, including insurance, medical care and transportation services, which are closely tied to wages.
segments.tr: - **आवास को छोड़कर सेवाएँ**, जिसमें बीमा, चिकित्सा देखभाल और परिवहन सेवाएँ शामिल हैं, जो मजदूरी से निकटता से जुड़ी हुई हैं।

segments.src: - **Used vehicle and auto insurance prices**, which have been notable sources of volatility in recent years.
segments.tr: - **पुराने वाहन और ऑटो बीमा की कीमतें**, जो हाल के वर्षों में अस्थिरता के उल्लेखनीय स्रोत रहे हैं।

segments.src: ## How to Read the Report Without Overreacting
segments.tr: ## बिना अति-प्रतिक्रिया किए रिपोर्ट को कैसे पढ़ें

segments.src: A single month of data rarely tells the full story.
segments.tr: डेटा का एक महीना शायद ही कभी पूरी कहानी बताता है।

segments.src: A few habits can help:
segments.tr: कुछ आदतें मदद कर सकती हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Compare to expectations.** Markets react to surprises, not to the number alone.
segments.tr: 1. **उम्मीदों से तुलना करें।** बाजार आश्चर्य पर प्रतिक्रिया करते हैं, न कि केवल संख्या पर।

segments.src: 2. **Look at the trend.** Three- and six-month changes can smooth out one-off swings.
segments.tr: 2. **रुझान देखें।** तीन और छह महीने के बदलाव एक बार के झूलों को सुचारू कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: 3. **Separate headline from core.** A jump driven by energy may mean something different than a jump in services.
segments.tr: 3. **हेडलाइन को कोर से अलग करें।** ऊर्जा के कारण आई उछाल का मतलब सेवाओं में उछाल से कुछ अलग हो सकता है।

segments.src: 4. **Remember revisions and seasonal adjustments.** Data can be revised, and seasonal factors can distort individual months.
segments.tr: 4. **संशोधन और मौसमी समायोजन को याद रखें।** डेटा को संशोधित किया जा सकता है, और मौसमी कारक अलग-अलग महीनों को विकृत कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## Practical Takeaways for Your Budget
segments.tr: ## आपके बजट के लिए व्यावहारिक निष्कर्ष

segments.src: Whatever the report shows, a few general steps can help you stay prepared:
segments.tr: रिपोर्ट जो भी दिखाए, कुछ सामान्य कदम आपको तैयार रहने में मदद कर सकते हैं:

segments.src: - **Review your recurring expenses.** Rent or mortgage, utilities, groceries, transportation and insurance are the categories most affected by price changes.
segments.tr: - **अपने आवर्ती खर्चों की समीक्षा करें।** किराया या बंधक, उपयोगिताएँ, किराने का सामान, परिवहन और बीमा वे श्रेणियां हैं जो कीमतों में बदलाव से सबसे अधिक प्रभावित होती हैं।

segments.src: - **Check variable-rate debt.** Credit cards and some loans can be sensitive to interest rate expectations.
segments.tr: - **परिवर्तनीय-दर ऋण की जाँच करें।** क्रेडिट कार्ड और कुछ ऋण ब्याज दर की उम्मीदों के प्रति संवेदनशील हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Compare savings options.** If rates stay higher for longer, savings accounts and certificates of deposit may continue to offer competitive yields, though terms vary by institution.
segments.tr: - **बचत विकल्पों की तुलना करें।** यदि दरें लंबे समय तक अधिक रहती हैं, तो बचत खाते और जमा प्रमाणपत्र प्रतिस्पर्धी यील्ड की पेशकश जारी रख सकते हैं, हालांकि शर्तें संस्थान के अनुसार भिन्न होती हैं।

segments.src: - **Build flexibility.** A small cushion for unexpected price increases can make a month-to-month budget easier to manage.
segments.tr: - **लचीलापन बनाएँ।** अप्रत्याशित मूल्य वृद्धि के लिए एक छोटा कुशन महीने-दर-महीने के बजट को प्रबंधित करना आसान बना सकता है।

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: The September CPI report will offer fresh evidence on whether inflation is continuing to cool or proving more persistent.
segments.tr: सितंबर सीपीआई रिपोर्ट इस बात पर ताजा सबूत पेश करेगी कि क्या मुद्रास्फीति ठंडी हो रही है या अधिक लगातार बनी हुई है।

segments.src: Shelter, food and energy are the categories most likely to shape both the headline number and the way households experience prices day to day.
segments.tr: आवास, भोजन और ऊर्जा वे श्रेणियां हैं जो हेडलाइन संख्या और परिवारों द्वारा दिन-प्रतिदिन कीमतों का अनुभव करने के तरीके को आकार देने की सबसे अधिक संभावना रखती हैं।

segments.src: The reading could influence expectations for the Fed's next move, but the central bank will also weigh employment data and other indicators before making a decision.
segments.tr: यह रीडिंग फेड के अगले कदम के लिए उम्मीदों को प्रभावित कर सकती है, लेकिन केंद्रीय बैंक निर्णय लेने से पहले रोजगार के आंकड़ों और अन्य संकेतकों को भी तौलेगा।

segments.src: For the latest figures, consult the Bureau of Labor Statistics at bls.gov and the Federal Reserve at federalreserve.gov.
segments.tr: नवीनतम आंकड़ों के लिए, bls.gov पर श्रम सांख्यिकी ब्यूरो और federalreserve.gov पर फेडरल रिजर्व से परामर्श करें।

segments.src: Economic conditions change quickly, and readers should consult official sources and a qualified professional before making financial decisions.*

es.title: Próximo informe del IPC de septiembre: Qué observar en los precios de la vivienda, los alimentos y la energía

segments.src: The next Consumer Price Index (CPI) report is one of the most closely followed economic releases of the year.
segments.tr: El próximo informe del Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC) es uno de los comunicados económicos más seguidos del año.

segments.src: With energy costs in focus, longer-term Treasury yields elevated and the Federal Reserve's next policy meeting approaching, the September reading could shape how markets and households think about interest rates in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Con los costos de la energía en el punto de mira, los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro a más largo plazo elevados y la próxima reunión de política de la Reserva Federal acercándose, la lectura de septiembre podría moldear la forma en que los mercados y los hogares perciben las tasas de interés en los próximos meses.

segments.src: This guide explains what the report measures, which categories deserve the closest attention, and how price changes can show up in a typical household budget.
segments.tr: Esta guía explica qué mide el informe, qué categorías merecen mayor atención y cómo los cambios de precios pueden reflejarse en el presupuesto de un hogar típico.

segments.src: It is general educational information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: Se trata de información educativa general, no de asesoramiento financiero.

segments.src: ## What the CPI Actually Measures
segments.tr: ## Lo que el IPC mide realmente

segments.src: The CPI, published by the U.S.
segments.tr: El IPC, publicado por la U.S.

segments.src: Bureau of Labor Statistics, tracks how the prices of a broad basket of goods and services change over time.
segments.tr: Oficina de Estadísticas Laborales (Bureau of Labor Statistics), rastrea cómo cambian con el tiempo los precios de una amplia cesta de bienes y servicios.

segments.src: That basket includes housing, food, transportation, medical care, apparel, recreation and more.
segments.tr: Esa cesta incluye vivienda, alimentos, transporte, atención médica, ropa, recreación y más.

segments.src: Two versions get the most attention:
segments.tr: Dos versiones reciben la mayor atención:

segments.src: - **Headline CPI** covers all items, including food and energy.
segments.tr: - **IPC general (Headline CPI)** abarca todos los artículos, incluidos los alimentos y la energía.

segments.src: - **Core CPI** excludes food and energy, which tend to swing from month to month. Many economists use it as a cleaner read on underlying inflation trends.
segments.tr: - **IPC subyacente (Core CPI)** excluye los alimentos y la energía, que tienden a oscilar de mes a mes. Muchos economistas lo utilizan como una lectura más clara de las tendencias inflacionarias subyacentes.

segments.src: Both are reported as a monthly change and as a year-over-year change.
segments.tr: Ambos se informan como un cambio mensual y como un cambio interanual.

segments.src: Analysts often compare the actual numbers with the consensus forecast, since a surprise in either direction can move markets.
segments.tr: Los analistas suelen comparar las cifras reales con el pronóstico de consenso, ya que una sorpresa en cualquier dirección puede mover los mercados.

segments.src: ## Why the Fed Pays Close Attention
segments.tr: ## Por qué la Fed presta tanta atención

segments.src: The Federal Reserve has a dual mandate: stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: La Reserva Federal tiene un doble mandato: precios estables y empleo máximo.

segments.src: When it sets its benchmark interest rate, it weighs inflation data against labor market conditions.
segments.tr: Cuando establece su tasa de interés de referencia, sopesa los datos de inflación frente a las condiciones del mercado laboral.

segments.src: - If inflation cools in line with or faster than expected, policymakers may feel more comfortable easing policy.
segments.tr: - Si la inflación se enfría en línea con lo esperado o más rápido de lo previsto, los responsables de las políticas pueden sentirse más cómodos relajando la política monetaria.

segments.src: - If inflation proves stubborn, the Fed may hold rates steady for longer, and some investors may reduce their expectations for rate cuts.
segments.tr: - Si la inflación resulta ser persistente, la Fed puede mantener las tasas estables por más tiempo, y algunos inversores pueden reducir sus expectativas de recortes de tasas.

segments.src: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge is actually the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, but CPI arrives earlier and is widely used as a signal for what PCE may show.
segments.tr: El indicador de inflación preferido de la Fed es en realidad el índice de precios de los Gastos de Consumo Personal (PCE), pero el IPC llega antes y se utiliza ampliamente como una señal de lo que el PCE podría mostrar.

segments.src: That is why a single CPI release can carry so much weight.
segments.tr: Es por eso que una sola publicación del IPC puede tener tanto peso.

segments.src: ## The Rate Backdrop: Yields and Borrowing Costs
segments.tr: ## El contexto de las tasas: rendimientos y costos de endeudamiento

segments.src: Longer-term Treasury yields influence borrowing costs across the economy, including mortgage rates, auto loans and business financing.
segments.tr: Los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro a más largo plazo influyen en los costos de endeudamiento en toda la economía, incluidas las tasas hipotecarias, los préstamos para automóviles y la financiación empresarial.

segments.src: When yields rise, those costs often move up as well, even if the Fed has not changed its own policy rate.
segments.tr: Cuando los rendimientos suben, esos costos a menudo aumentan también, incluso si la Fed no ha cambiado su propia tasa de política monetaria.

segments.src: Because yields reflect expectations about future inflation and future Fed decisions, a CPI report that changes those expectations can ripple quickly through bond markets.
segments.tr: Debido a que los rendimientos reflejan las expectativas sobre la inflación futura y las futuras decisiones de la Fed, un informe del IPC que cambie esas expectativas puede propagarse rápidamente a través de los mercados de bonos.

segments.src: For households, that can mean changes in what it costs to finance a home, a car or a large purchase.
segments.tr: Para los hogares, eso puede significar cambios en lo que cuesta financiar una casa, un automóvil o una compra grande.

segments.src: ## Category One: Shelter
segments.tr: ## Categoría uno: Vivienda

segments.src: Shelter, which includes rent and owners' equivalent rent, is the largest single component of the CPI.
segments.tr: La vivienda, que incluye el alquiler y el equivalente de alquiler de los propietarios, es el componente individual más grande del IPC.

segments.src: Because it carries so much weight, even small monthly changes can have a noticeable effect on the overall number.
segments.tr: Debido a que tiene tanto peso, incluso los pequeños cambios mensuales pueden tener un efecto notable en la cifra general.

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: Qué observar:

segments.src: - **Rent and owners' equivalent rent.** These measures often move gradually, since they reflect leases that renew over time. A steady cooling trend would be a welcome sign for inflation watchers.
segments.tr: - **Alquiler y equivalente de alquiler de los propietarios.** Estas medidas suelen moverse gradualmente, ya que reflejan contratos de arrendamiento que se renuevan con el tiempo. Una tendencia constante de enfriamiento sería una señal bienvenida para los observadores de la inflación.

segments.src: - **Lodging away from home.** Hotel prices can be volatile and may add noise to the monthly figure.
segments.tr: - **Alojamiento fuera del hogar.** Los precios de los hoteles pueden ser volátiles y pueden añadir ruido a la cifra mensual.

segments.src: **Household impact:** For renters, shelter costs are often the biggest line in the budget.
segments.tr: **Impacto en los hogares:** Para los inquilinos, los costos de la vivienda suelen ser la partida más importante del presupuesto.

segments.src: Lease renewals, rather than the monthly CPI release, are usually what change your actual rent, but the broader trend can signal what to expect.
segments.tr: Las renovaciones de contratos de arrendamiento, en lugar de la publicación mensual del IPC, son por lo general lo que cambia su alquiler real, pero la tendencia general puede indicar qué esperar.

segments.src: ## Category Two: Food
segments.tr: ## Categoría dos: Alimentos

segments.src: Food prices are divided into two parts:
segments.tr: Los precios de los alimentos se dividen en dos partes:

segments.src: - **Food at home**, meaning groceries.
segments.tr: - **Alimentos en el hogar**, es decir, comestibles.

segments.src: - **Food away from home**, meaning restaurants and takeout.
segments.tr: - **Alimentos fuera del hogar**, es decir, restaurantes y comida para llevar.

segments.src: Grocery prices can respond to weather, supply chain conditions, transportation costs and global commodity markets.
segments.tr: Los precios de los supermercados pueden responder al clima, las condiciones de la cadena de suministro, los costos de transporte y los mercados mundiales de materias primas.

segments.src: Restaurant prices tend to be stickier because they reflect labor and rent costs that do not change quickly.
segments.tr: Los precios de los restaurantes tienden a ser más rígidos porque reflejan los costos de mano de obra y alquiler que no cambian rápidamente.

segments.src: **Household impact:** Food is a frequent purchase, so price changes are felt quickly.
segments.tr: **Impacto en los hogares:** Los alimentos son una compra frecuente, por lo que los cambios de precios se sienten rápidamente.

segments.src: Many consumers say grocery costs shape their view of the economy more than any headline statistic.
segments.tr: Muchos consumidores dicen que los costos de los comestibles moldean su visión de la economía más que cualquier estadística principal.

segments.src: ## Category Three: Energy
segments.tr: ## Categoría tres: Energía

segments.src: Energy includes gasoline, electricity, natural gas and fuel oil.
segments.tr: La energía incluye gasolina, electricidad, gas natural y fuelóleo.

segments.src: It is typically the most volatile part of the CPI.
segments.tr: Por lo general, es la parte más volátil del IPC.

segments.src: Diesel costs deserve attention because diesel powers trucks, freight and farm equipment, so higher fuel costs can eventually feed into the prices of many goods.
segments.tr: Los costos del diésel merecen atención porque el diésel alimenta a los camiones, el transporte de carga y los equipos agrícolas, por lo que unos mayores costos de combustible pueden eventualmente repercutir en los precios de muchos bienes.

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: Qué observar:

segments.src: - **Gasoline.** Often the biggest swing factor in the headline number from month to month.
segments.tr: - **Gasolina.** A menudo es el mayor factor de fluctuación en la cifra principal de mes a mes.

segments.src: - **Utilities.** Electricity and natural gas bills can shift with seasonal demand and fuel costs.
segments.tr: - **Servicios públicos.** Las facturas de electricidad y gas natural pueden cambiar con la demanda estacional y los costos de combustible.

segments.src: - **Pass-through effects.** Higher transportation costs may show up later in goods prices, which is why analysts look beyond the energy line itself.
segments.tr: - **Efectos de transferencia.** Los mayores costos de transporte pueden aparecer más tarde en los precios de los bienes, razón por la cual los analistas miran más allá de la línea de energía en sí.

segments.src: **Household impact:** Fuel and utility costs affect commuters, families who drive long distances and anyone with a large heating or cooling bill.
segments.tr: **Impacto en los hogares:** Los costos de combustible y servicios públicos afectan a los viajeros diarios, las familias que conducen largas distancias y cualquier persona con una factura grande de calefacción o refrigeración.

segments.src: ## Other Areas Worth a Look
segments.tr: ## Otras áreas que vale la más pena revisar

segments.src: Beyond the big three, analysts will also check:
segments.tr: Más allá de los tres grandes, los analistas también comprobarán:

segments.src: - **Core goods**, such as vehicles, furniture and apparel.
segments.tr: - **Bienes básicos**, como vehículos, muebles y ropa.

segments.src: - **Services excluding shelter**, including insurance, medical care and transportation services, which are closely tied to wages.
segments.tr: - **Servicios excluyendo la vivienda**, incluidos seguros, atención médica y servicios de transporte, que están estrechamente vinculados a los salarios.

segments.src: - **Used vehicle and auto insurance prices**, which have been notable sources of volatility in recent years.
segments.tr: - **Precios de vehículos usados y seguros de automóviles**, que han sido fuentes notables de volatilidad en los últimos años.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Report Without Overreacting
segments.tr: ## Cómo leer el informe sin reaccionar exageradamente

segments.src: A single month of data rarely tells the full story.
segments.tr: Un solo mes de datos rara vez cuenta toda la historia.

segments.src: A few habits can help:
segments.tr: Algunos hábitos pueden ayudar:

segments.src: 1. **Compare to expectations.** Markets react to surprises, not to the number alone.
segments.tr: 1. **Comparar con las expectativas.** Los mercados reaccionan a las sorpresas, no al número por sí solo.

segments.src: 2. **Look at the trend.** Three- and six-month changes can smooth out one-off swings.
segments.tr: 2. **Observar la tendencia.** Los cambios a tres y seis meses pueden suavizar las fluctuaciones puntuales.

segments.src: 3. **Separate headline from core.** A jump driven by energy may mean something different than a jump in services.
segments.tr: 3. **Separar el titular del núcleo.** Un salto impulsado por la energía puede significar algo diferente que un salto en los servicios.

segments.src: 4. **Remember revisions and seasonal adjustments.** Data can be revised, and seasonal factors can distort individual months.
segments.tr: 4. **Recordar las revisiones y los ajustes estacionales.** Los datos pueden ser revisados y los factores estacionales pueden distorsionar los meses individuales.

segments.src: ## Practical Takeaways for Your Budget
segments.tr: ## Conclusiones prácticas para su presupuesto

segments.src: Whatever the report shows, a few general steps can help you stay prepared:
segments.tr: Independientemente de lo que muestre el informe, unos cuantos pasos generales pueden ayudarle a mantenerse preparado:

segments.src: - **Review your recurring expenses.** Rent or mortgage, utilities, groceries, transportation and insurance are the categories most affected by price changes.
segments.tr: - **Revise sus gastos recurrentes.** El alquiler o la hipoteca, los servicios públicos, los comestibles, el transporte y los seguros son las categorías más afectadas por los cambios de precios.

segments.src: - **Check variable-rate debt.** Credit cards and some loans can be sensitive to interest rate expectations.
segments.tr: - **Compruebe la deuda a tasa variable.** Las tarjetas de crédito y algunos préstamos pueden ser sensibles a las expectativas de las tasas de interés.

segments.src: - **Compare savings options.** If rates stay higher for longer, savings accounts and certificates of deposit may continue to offer competitive yields, though terms vary by institution.
segments.tr: - **Compare opciones de ahorro.** Si las tasas se mantienen más altas por más tiempo, las cuentas de ahorro y los certificados de depósito pueden seguir ofreciendo rendimientos competitivos, aunque los términos varían según la institución.

segments.src: - **Build flexibility.** A small cushion for unexpected price increases can make a month-to-month budget easier to manage.
segments.tr: - **Construya flexibilidad.** Un pequeño colchón para aumentos de precios inesperados puede hacer que un presupuesto mensual sea más fácil de administrar.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## El resultado final

segments.src: The September CPI report will offer fresh evidence on whether inflation is continuing to cool or proving more persistent.
segments.tr: El informe del IPC de septiembre ofrecerá nuevas pruebas sobre si la inflación continúa enfriándose o si resulta más persistente.

segments.src: Shelter, food and energy are the categories most likely to shape both the headline number and the way households experience prices day to day.
segments.tr: La vivienda, los alimentos y la energía son las categorías con más probabilidades de moldear tanto la cifra principal como la forma en que los hogares experimentan los precios día a día.

segments.src: The reading could influence expectations for the Fed's next move, but the central bank will also weigh employment data and other indicators before making a decision.
segments.tr: La lectura podría influir en las expectativas para el próximo movimiento de la Fed, pero el banco central también sopesará los datos de empleo y otros indicadores antes de tomar una decisión.

segments.src: For the latest figures, consult the Bureau of Labor Statistics at bls.gov and the Federal Reserve at federalreserve.gov.
segments.tr: Para obtener las últimas cifras, consulte a la Oficina de Estadísticas Laborales en bls.gov y a la Reserva Federal en federalreserve.gov.

segments.src: ## Why the Fed Pays Close Attention
segments.tr: ## لماذا يولي الفيدرالي اهتمامًا وثيقًا

segments.tr: مقياس التضخم المفضل لدى الفيدرالي هو في الواقع مؤشر أسعار نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي (PCE)، لكن مؤشر أسعار المستهلكين يصل مبكرًا ويستخدم على نطاق واسع كإشارة لما قد يظهره مؤشر نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي.

segments.src: That is why a single CPI release can carry so much weight.
segments.tr: لهذا السبب يمكن لإصدار واحد لمؤشر أسعار المستهلكين أن يحمل وزنًا كبيرًا.

segments.src: ## The Rate Backdrop: Yields and Borrowing Costs
segments.tr: ## خلفية أسعار الفائدة: العوائد وتكاليف الاقتراض

segments.src: When yields rise, those costs often move up as well, even if the Fed has not changed its own policy rate.

segments.src: Because yields reflect expectations about future inflation and future Fed decisions, a CPI report that changes those expectations can ripple quickly through bond markets.
segments.tr: نظرًا لأن العوائد تعكس التوقعات بشأن التضخم المستقبلي وقرارات الفيدرالي المستقبلية، فإن تقرير مؤشر أسعار المستهلكين الذي يغير تلك التوقعات يمكن أن يتغلغل بسرعة عبر أسواق السندات.

segments.src: For households, that can mean changes in what it costs to finance a home, a car or a large purchase.

segments.src: ## Category One: Shelter
segments.tr: ## الفئة الأولى: الإسكان

segments.src: Shelter, which includes rent and owners' equivalent rent, is the largest single component of the CPI.
segments.tr: الإسكان، والذي يشمل الإيجار والإيجار المكافئ للمالكين، هو أكبر مكون فردي في مؤشر أسعار المستهلكين.

segments.tr: - **الإيجار والإيجار المكافئ للمالكين.** غالبًا ما يتحرك هذان المقياسان تدريجيًا، لأنهما يعكسان عقود الإيجار التي تتجدد بمرور الوقت. سيكون اتجاه التبريد الثابت علامة مرحب بها لمراقبي التضخم.

segments.tr: - **الإقامة بعيدًا عن المنزل.** يمكن أن تكون أسعار الفنادق متقلبة وقد تضيف ضوضاء إلى الرقم الشهري.

segments.src: ## Category Two: Food
segments.tr: ## الفئة الثانية: الغذاء

segments.src: Food prices are divided into two parts:
segments.tr: تنقسم أسعار الغذاء إلى جزأين:

segments.src: Grocery prices can respond to weather, supply chain conditions, transportation costs and global commodity markets.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تستجيب أسعار البقالة للطقس وظروف سلسلة التوريد وتكاليف النقل وأسواق السلع العالمية.

segments.src: Restaurant prices tend to be stickier because they reflect labor and rent costs that do not change quickly.
segments.tr: تميل أسعار المطاعم إلى أن تكون أكثر لزوجة لأنها تعكس تكاليف العمالة والإيجار التي لا تتغير بسرعة.

segments.src: **Household impact:** Food is a frequent purchase, so price changes are felt quickly.
segments.tr: **تأثير الأسرة:** الغذاء عملية شراء متكررة، لذا يتم الشعور بتغيرات الأسعار بسرعة.

segments.src: Many consumers say grocery costs shape their view of the economy more than any headline statistic.
segments.tr: يقول العديد من المستهلكين إن تكاليف البقالة تشكل نظرتهم للاقتصاد أكثر من أي إحصائية رئيسية.

segments.src: ## Category Three: Energy
segments.tr: ## الفئة الثالثة: الطاقة

segments.src: Energy includes gasoline, electricity, natural gas and fuel oil.
segments.tr: تشمل الطاقة البنزين والكهرباء والغاز الطبيعي وزيت التدفئة.

segments.src: It is typically the most volatile part of the CPI.
segments.tr: عادة ما يكون الجزء الأكثر تقلبًا في مؤشر أسعار المستهلكين.

segments.src: Diesel costs deserve attention because diesel powers trucks, freight and farm equipment, so higher fuel costs can eventually feed into the prices of many goods.
segments.tr: تستحق تكاليف الديزل الاهتمام لأن الديزل يغذي الشاحنات والشحن والمعدات الزراعية، لذا فإن ارتفاع تكاليف الوقود يمكن أن يغذي في النهاية أسعار العديد من السلع.

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: ما يجب مراقبته:

segments.src: - **Gasoline.** Often the biggest swing factor in the headline number from month to month.
segments.tr: - **البنزين.** غالبًا ما يكون عامل التأرجح الأكبر في الرقم الرئيسي من شهر لآخر.

segments.src: - **Utilities.** Electricity and natural gas bills can shift with seasonal demand and fuel costs.
segments.tr: - **المرافق.** يمكن أن تتغير فواتير الكهرباء والغاز الطبيعي مع الطلب الموسمي وتكاليف الوقود.

segments.src: - **Pass-through effects.** Higher transportation costs may show up later in goods prices, which is why analysts look beyond the energy line itself.
segments.tr: - **آثار التمرير.** قد تظهر تكاليف النقل الأعلى لاحقًا في أسعار السلع، ولهذا السبب ينظر المحللون إلى ما هو أبعد من خط الطاقة نفسه.

segments.src: **Household impact:** Fuel and utility costs affect commuters, families who drive long distances and anyone with a large heating or cooling bill.
segments.tr: **تأثير الأسرة:** تؤثر تكاليف الوقود والمرافق على الركاب، والعائلات التي تقود مسافات طويلة، وأي شخص لديه فاتورة تدفئة أو تبريد كبيرة.

segments.src: ## Other Areas Worth a Look
segments.tr: ## مناطق أخرى تستحق نظرة

segments.src: Beyond the big three, analysts will also check:
segments.tr: بخلاف الثلاثة الكبار، سيتحقق المحللون أيضًا من:

segments.src: - **Core goods**, such as vehicles, furniture and apparel.
segments.tr: - **السلع الأساسية**، مثل المركبات والأثاث والملابس.

segments.src: - **Services excluding shelter**, including insurance, medical care and transportation services, which are closely tied to wages.
segments.tr: - **الخدمات باستثناء الإسكان**، بما في ذلك التأمين والرعاية الطبية وخدمات النقل، والتي ترتبط ارتباطًا وثيقًا بالأجور.

segments.src: - **Used vehicle and auto insurance prices**, which have been notable sources of volatility in recent years.
segments.tr: - **أسعار المركبات المستعملة وتأمين السيارات**، والتي كانت مصادر بارزة للتقلب في السنوات الأخيرة.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Report Without Overreacting
segments.tr: ## كيفية قراءة التقرير دون مبالغة في رد الفعل

segments.src: A single month of data rarely tells the full story.
segments.tr: نادراً ما يروي شهر واحد من البيانات القصة كاملة.

segments.src: A few habits can help:
segments.tr: يمكن لبعض العادات أن تساعد:

segments.src: 1. **Compare to expectations.** Markets react to surprises, not to the number alone.
segments.tr: 1. **المقارنة بالتوقعات.** تتفاعل الأسواق مع المفاجآت، وليس مع الرقم وحده.

segments.src: 2. **Look at the trend.** Three- and six-month changes can smooth out one-off swings.
segments.tr: 2. **النظر إلى الاتجاه.** يمكن للتغيرات لمدة ثلاثة وستة أشهر أن تساهم في تسوية التقلبات لمرة واحدة.

segments.src: 3. **Separate headline from core.** A jump driven by energy may mean something different than a jump in services.
segments.tr: 3. **فصل العنوان الرئيسي عن الأساسي.** قد يعني القفزة المدفوعة بالطاقة شيئًا مختلفًا عن القفزة في الخدمات.

segments.src: 4. **Remember revisions and seasonal adjustments.** Data can be revised, and seasonal factors can distort individual months.
segments.tr: 4. **تذكر المراجعات والتعديلات الموسمية.** يمكن مراجعة البيانات، ويمكن للعوامل الموسمية تشويه الأشهر الفردية.

segments.src: ## Practical Takeaways for Your Budget
segments.tr: ## الوجبات العملية لميزانيتك

segments.src: Whatever the report shows, a few general steps can help you stay prepared:
segments.tr: مهما كان ما يظهره التقرير، يمكن لبعض الخطوات العامة أن تساعدك على البقاء مستعدًا:

segments.src: - **Review your recurring expenses.** Rent or mortgage, utilities, groceries, transportation and insurance are the categories most affected by price changes.
segments.tr: - **مراجعة نفقاتك المتكررة.** الإيجار أو الرهن العقاري، والمرافق، والبقالة، والنقل، والتامين هي الفئات الأكثر تأثراً بتغيرات الأسعار.

segments.src: - **Check variable-rate debt.** Credit cards and some loans can be sensitive to interest rate expectations.
segments.tr: - **تحقق من الديون ذات الفائدة المتغيرة.** بطاقات الائتمان وبعض القروض يمكن أن تكون حساسة لتوقعات أسعار الفائدة.

segments.src: - **Compare savings options.** If rates stay higher for longer, savings accounts and certificates of deposit may continue to offer competitive yields, though terms vary by institution.
segments.tr: - **قارن خيارات التوفير.** إذا ظلت أسعار الفائدة مرتفعة لفترة أطول، فقد تستمر حسابات التوفير وشهادات الإيداع في تقديم عوائد تنافسية، على الرغم من اختلاف الشروط حسب المؤسسة.

segments.src: - **Build flexibility.** A small cushion for unexpected price increases can make a month-to-month budget easier to manage.
segments.tr: - **بناء المرونة.** يمكن وسادة صغيرة لزيادات الأسعار غير المتوقعة أن تجعل ميزانية الشهر بالشهر أسهل في الإدارة.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.tr: سيقدم تقرير مؤشر أسعار المستهلكين لشهر سبتمبر دليلًا جديدًا حول ما إذا كان التضخم يواصل التبريد أم يثبت أنه أكثر استمرارًا.

segments.src: Shelter, food and energy are the categories most likely to shape both the headline number and the way households experience prices day to day.
segments.tr: الإسكان والغذاء والطاقة هي الفئات الأكثر ترجيحًا لتشكيل كل من الرقم الرئيسي والطريقة التي تشعر بها الأسر بالأسعار يومًا بعد يوم.

segments.src: The reading could influence expectations for the Fed's next move, but the central bank will also weigh employment data and other indicators before making a decision.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تؤثر القراءة على التوقعات للخطوة التالية للفيدرالي، لكن البنك المركزي سيوازن أيضًا بيانات التضخم ومؤشرات أخرى قبل اتخاذ القرار.
