fr.title: Rapport sur l'IPC de septembre à venir : ce qu'il faut surveiller dans les prix du logement, de l'alimentation et de l'énergie

segments.src: The next Consumer Price Index (CPI) report is one of the most closely followed economic releases of the year.
segments.tr: Le prochain rapport sur l'indice des prix à la consommation (IPC) est l'une des publications économiques les plus suivies de l'année.

segments.src: With energy costs in focus, longer-term Treasury yields elevated and the Federal Reserve's next policy meeting approaching, the September reading could shape how markets and households think about interest rates in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Alors que les coûts de l'énergie sont au premier plan, que les rendements du Trésor à long terme restent élevés et que la prochaine réunion de politique monétaire de la Réserve fédérale approche, les chiffres de septembre pourraient influencer la façon dont les marchés et les ménages perçoivent les taux d'intérêt dans les mois à venir.

segments.src: This guide explains what the report measures, which categories deserve the closest attention, and how price changes can show up in a typical household budget.
segments.tr: Ce guide explique ce que mesure le rapport, quelles catégories méritent la plus grande attention et comment les variations de prix peuvent se répercuter sur le budget d'un ménage type.

segments.src: It is general educational information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: Il s'agit d'informations générales à caractère éducatif, et non de conseils financiers.

segments.src: ## What the CPI Actually Measures
segments.tr: ## Ce que mesure réellement l'IPC

segments.src: The CPI, published by the U.S.
segments.tr: L'IPC, publié par le U.S.

segments.src: Bureau of Labor Statistics, tracks how the prices of a broad basket of goods and services change over time.
segments.tr: Bureau of Labor Statistics, suit l'évolution dans le temps des prix d'un vaste panier de biens et de services.

segments.src: That basket includes housing, food, transportation, medical care, apparel, recreation and more.
segments.tr: Ce panier comprend le logement, l'alimentation, le transport, les soins médicaux, l'habillement, les loisirs et bien plus encore.

segments.src: Two versions get the most attention:
segments.tr: Deux versions retiennent le plus l'attention :

segments.src: - **Headline CPI** covers all items, including food and energy.
segments.tr: - **IPC global** (Headline CPI) couvre tous les postes, y compris l'alimentation et l'énergie.

segments.src: - **Core CPI** excludes food and energy, which tend to swing from month to month. Many economists use it as a cleaner read on underlying inflation trends.
segments.tr: - **IPC sous-jacent** (Core CPI) exclut l'alimentation et l'énergie, qui ont tendance à fluctuer d'un mois à l'autre. De nombreux économistes l'utilisent comme un indicateur plus fiable des tendances inflationnistes de fond.

segments.src: Both are reported as a monthly change and as a year-over-year change.
segments.tr: Les deux sont publiés sous forme de variation mensuelle et de variation sur un an.

segments.src: Analysts often compare the actual numbers with the consensus forecast, since a surprise in either direction can move markets.
segments.tr: Les analystes comparent souvent les chiffres réels aux prévisions consensuelles, car une surprise dans un sens ou dans l'autre peut faire bouger les marchés.

segments.src: ## Why the Fed Pays Close Attention
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la Fed y prête une attention particulière

segments.src: The Federal Reserve has a dual mandate: stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: La Réserve fédérale a un double mandat : la stabilité des prix et le plein emploi.

segments.src: When it sets its benchmark interest rate, it weighs inflation data against labor market conditions.
segments.tr: Lorsqu'elle fixe son taux directeur, elle met en balance les données sur l'inflation et les conditions du marché du travail.

segments.src: - If inflation cools in line with or faster than expected, policymakers may feel more comfortable easing policy.
segments.tr: - Si l'inflation ralentit conformément aux prévisions ou plus rapidement que prévu, les décideurs politiques pourraient se sentir plus à l'aise pour assouplir leur politique.

segments.src: - If inflation proves stubborn, the Fed may hold rates steady for longer, and some investors may reduce their expectations for rate cuts.
segments.tr: - Si l'inflation s'avère tenace, la Fed pourrait maintenir ses taux stables plus longtemps, et certains investisseurs pourraient revoir à la baisse leurs attentes de ꞉baisse de taux.

segments.src: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge is actually the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, but CPI arrives earlier and is widely used as a signal for what PCE may show.
segments.tr: L'indicateur d'inflation privilégié par la Fed est en réalité l'indice des prix des dépenses de consommation personnelle (PCE), mais l'IPC arrive plus tôt et est largement utilisé comme signal de ce que le PCE pourrait montrer.

segments.src: That is why a single CPI release can carry so much weight.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi une seule publication de l'IPC peut avoir un tel poids.

segments.src: ## The Rate Backdrop: Yields and Borrowing Costs
segments.tr: ## Le contexte des taux : rendements et coûts d'emprunt

segments.src: Longer-term Treasury yields influence borrowing costs across the economy, including mortgage rates, auto loans and business financing.
segments.tr: Les rendements du Trésor à long terme influencent les coûts d'emprunt dans l'ensemble de l'économie, y compris les taux hypothécaires, les prêts automobiles et le financement des entreprises.

segments.src: When yields rise, those costs often move up as well, even if the Fed has not changed its own policy rate.
segments.tr: Lorsque les rendements augmentent, ces coûts ont tendance à augmenter également, même si la Fed n'a pas modifié son propre taux directeur.

segments.src: Because yields reflect expectations about future inflation and future Fed decisions, a CPI report that changes those expectations can ripple quickly through bond markets.
segments.tr: Étant donné que les rendements reflètent les attentes concernant l'inflation future et les décisions futures de la Fed, un rapport sur l'IPC qui modifie ces attentes peut se répercuter rapidement sur les marchés obligataires.

segments.src: For households, that can mean changes in what it costs to finance a home, a car or a large purchase.
segments.tr: Pour les ménages, cela peut signifier des changements dans le coût du financement d'un logement, d'une voiture ou d'un achat important.

segments.src: ## Category One: Shelter
segments.tr: ## Première catégorie : le logement (Shelter)

segments.src: Shelter, which includes rent and owners' equivalent rent, is the largest single component of the CPI.
segments.tr: Le logement, qui comprend le loyer et le loyer équivalent pour les propriétaires, est la plus importante composante de l'IPC.

segments.src: Because it carries so much weight, even small monthly changes can have a noticeable effect on the overall number.
segments.tr: Comme il pèse lourd, même de petits changements mensuels peuvent avoir un effet notable sur le chiffre global.

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: Ce qu'il faut surveiller :

segments.src: - **Rent and owners' equivalent rent.** These measures often move gradually, since they reflect leases that renew over time. A steady cooling trend would be a welcome sign for inflation watchers.
segments.tr: - **Le loyer et le loyer équivalent pour les propriétaires.** Ces mesures évoluent souvent progressivement, car elles reflètent des baux qui se renouvellent au fil du temps. Une tendance constante au ralentissement serait un signal bienvenu pour les observateurs de l'inflation.

segments.src: - **Lodging away from home.** Hotel prices can be volatile and may add noise to the monthly figure.
segments.tr: - **L'hébergement hors du domicile.** Les prix des hôtels peuvent être volatils et ajouter du bruit au chiffre mensuel.

segments.src: **Household impact:** For renters, shelter costs are often the biggest line in the budget.
segments.tr: **Impact sur les ménages :** Pour les locataires, les frais de logement représentent souvent la ligne budgétaire la plus importante.

segments.src: Lease renewals, rather than the monthly CPI release, are usually what change your actual rent, but the broader trend can signal what to expect.
segments.tr: Les renouvellements de bail, plutôt que la publication mensuelle de l'IPC, sont généralement ce qui modifie votre loyer réel, mais la tendance globale peut indiquer à quoi s'attendre.

segments.src: ## Category Two: Food
segments.tr: ## Deuxième catégorie : l'alimentation

segments.src: Food prices are divided into two parts:
segments.tr: Les prix des produits alimentaires sont divisés en deux parties :

segments.src: - **Food at home**, meaning groceries.
segments.tr: - **L'alimentation à domicile**, c'est-à-dire l'épicerie.

segments.src: - **Food away from home**, meaning restaurants and takeout.
segments.tr: - **L'alimentation hors domicile**, c'est-à-dire les restaurants et les plats à emporter.

segments.src: Grocery prices can respond to weather, supply chain conditions, transportation costs and global commodity markets.
segments.tr: Les prix de l'épicerie peuvent réagir à la météo, aux conditions de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, aux coûts de transport et aux marchés mondiaux des matières premières.

segments.src: Restaurant prices tend to be stickier because they reflect labor and rent costs that do not change quickly.
segments.tr: Les prix des restaurants ont tendance à être plus rigides car ils reflètent les coûts de main-d'œuvre et de loyer qui ne changent pas rapidement.

segments.src: **Household impact:** Food is a frequent purchase, so price changes are felt quickly.
segments.tr: **Impact sur les ménages :** L'alimentation est un achat fréquent, de sorte que les variations de prix se font sentir rapidement.

segments.src: Many consumers say grocery costs shape their view of the economy more than any headline statistic.
segments.tr: De nombreux consommateurs affirment que le coût de l'épicerie façonne leur vision de l'économie plus que n'importe quelle statistique globale.

segments.src: ## Category Three: Energy
segments.tr: ## Troisième catégorie : l'énergie

segments.src: Energy includes gasoline, electricity, natural gas and fuel oil.
segments.tr: L'énergie comprend l'essence, l'électricité, le gaz naturel et le fioul domestique.

segments.src: It is typically the most volatile part of the CPI.
segments.tr: C'est généralement la partie la plus volatile de l'IPC.

segments.src: Diesel costs deserve attention because diesel powers trucks, freight and farm equipment, so higher fuel costs can eventually feed into the prices of many goods.
segments.tr: Les coûts du diesel méritent l'attention car le diesel alimente les camions, le fret et le matériel agricole, de sorte que des coûts de carburant plus élevés peuvent finir par se répercuter sur les prix de nombreux biens.

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: Ce qu'il faut surveiller :

segments.src: - **Gasoline.** Often the biggest swing factor in the headline number from month to month.
segments.tr: - **L'essence.** Souvent le plus grand facteur de fluctuation du chiffre global d'un mois à l'autre.

segments.src: - **Utilities.** Electricity and natural gas bills can shift with seasonal demand and fuel costs.
segments.tr: - **Les services publics.** Les factures d'électricité et de gaz naturel peuvent varier en fonction de la demande saisonnière et des coûts du combustible.

segments.src: - **Pass-through effects.** Higher transportation costs may show up later in goods prices, which is why analysts look beyond the energy line itself.
segments.tr: - **Les effets de transmission.** Des coûts de transport plus élevés peuvent apparaître plus tard dans les prix des biens, c'est pourquoi les analystes regardent au-delà du poste énergétique lui-même.

segments.src: **Household impact:** Fuel and utility costs affect commuters, families who drive long distances and anyone with a large heating or cooling bill.
segments.tr: **Impact sur les ménages :** Les coûts du carburant et des services publics touchent les navetteurs, les familles qui parcourent de longues distances et toute personne ayant une facture de chauffage ou de climatisation importante.

segments.src: ## Other Areas Worth a Look
segments.tr: ## Autres domaines à examiner

segments.src: Beyond the big three, analysts will also check:
segments.tr: Au-delà des trois grands, les analystes vérifieront également :

segments.src: - **Core goods**, such as vehicles, furniture and apparel.
segments.tr: - **Les biens de base (Core goods)**, tels que les véhicules, les meubles et l'habillement.

segments.src: - **Services excluding shelter**, including insurance, medical care and transportation services, which are closely tied to wages.
segments.tr: - **Les services hors logement**, y compris l'assurance, les soins médicaux et les services de transport, qui sont étroitement liés aux salaires.

segments.src: - **Used vehicle and auto insurance prices**, which have been notable sources of volatility in recent years.
segments.tr: - **Les prix des véhicules d'occasion et de l'assurance automobile**, qui ont été des sources notables de volatilité ces dernières années.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Report Without Overreacting
segments.tr: ## Comment lire le rapport sans surréagir

segments.src: A single month of data rarely tells the full story.
segments.tr: Un seul mois de données raconte rarement toute l'histoire.

segments.src: A few habits can help:
segments.tr: Quelques habitudes peuvent aider :

segments.src: 1. **Compare to expectations.** Markets react to surprises, not to the number alone.
segments.tr: 1. **Comparer aux attentes.** Les marchés réagissent aux surprises, pas seulement au chiffre brut.

segments.src: 2. **Look at the trend.** Three- and six-month changes can smooth out one-off swings.
segments.tr: 2. **Regarder la tendance.** Les variations sur trois et six mois permettent d'atténuer les fluctuations ponctuelles.

segments.src: 3. **Separate headline from core.** A jump driven by energy may mean something different than a jump in services.
segments.tr: 3. **Séparer l'indice global de l'indice de référence.** Un bond provoqué par l'énergie peut signifier quelque chose de différent d'un bond dans les services.

segments.src: 4. **Remember revisions and seasonal adjustments.** Data can be revised, and seasonal factors can distort individual months.
segments.tr: 4. **Se souvenir des révisions et des ajustements saisonniers.** Les données peuvent être révisées et les facteurs saisonniers peuvent fausser des mois individuels.

segments.src: ## Practical Takeaways for Your Budget
segments.tr: ## Enseignements pratiques pour votre budget

segments.src: Whatever the report shows, a few general steps can help you stay prepared:
segments.tr: Quel que soit le contenu du rapport, quelques mesures générales peuvent vous aider à rester préparé :

segments.src: - **Review your recurring expenses.** Rent or mortgage, utilities, groceries, transportation and insurance are the categories most affected by price changes.
segments.tr: - **Examiner vos dépenses récurrentes.** Le loyer ou l'emprunt immobilier, les services publics, l'épicerie, le transport et l'assurance sont les catégories les plus touchées par les variations de prix.

segments.src: - **Check variable-rate debt.** Credit cards and some loans can be sensitive to interest rate expectations.

pt.title: Relatório do IPC de Setembro se Aproxima: O Que Observar nos Preços de Moradia, Alimentação e Energia

segments.src: The next Consumer Price Index (CPI) report is one of the most closely followed economic releases of the year.
segments.tr: O próximo relatório do Índice de Preços ao Consumidor (IPC) é um dos lançamentos econômicos mais acompanhados do ano.

segments.src: With energy costs in focus, longer-term Treasury yields elevated and the Federal Reserve's next policy meeting approaching, the September reading could shape how markets and households think about interest rates in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Com os custos de energia em destaque, os rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro de longo prazo elevados e a próxima reunião de política do Federal Reserve se aproximando, a leitura de setembro pode moldar como os mercados e as famílias pensam sobre as taxas de juros nos próximos meses.

segments.src: This guide explains what the report measures, which categories deserve the closest attention, and how price changes can show up in a typical household budget.
segments.tr: Este guia explica o que o relatório mede, quais categorias merecem maior atenção e como as variações de preços podem aparecer no orçamento familiar típico.

segments.src: It is general educational information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: Trata-se de informação educacional geral, não de aconselhamento financeiro.

segments.src: ## What the CPI Actually Measures
segments.tr: ## O Que o IPC Realmente Mede

segments.src: The CPI, published by the U.S.
segments.tr: O IPC, publicado pelo U.S.

segments.src: Bureau of Labor Statistics, tracks how the prices of a broad basket of goods and services change over time.
segments.tr: Bureau of Labor Statistics, acompanha como os preços de uma ampla cesta de bens e serviços mudam ao longo do tempo.

segments.src: That basket includes housing, food, transportation, medical care, apparel, recreation and more.
segments.tr: Essa cesta inclui habitação, alimentação, transporte, cuidados médicos, vestuário, lazer e muito mais.

segments.src: Two versions get the most attention:
segments.tr: Duas versões recebem a maior atenção:

segments.src: - **Headline CPI** covers all items, including food and energy.
segments.tr: - **IPC Cheio (Headline)** abrange todos os itens, incluindo alimentação e energia.

segments.src: - **Core CPI** excludes food and energy, which tend to swing from month to month. Many economists use it as a cleaner read on underlying inflation trends.
segments.tr: - **Núcleo do IPC (Core)** exclui alimentação e energia, que tendem a oscilar de mês para mês. Muitos economistas o usam como uma leitura mais limpa das tendências subjacentes da inflação.

segments.src: Both are reported as a monthly change and as a year-over-year change.
segments.tr: Ambos são relatados como uma variação mensal e como uma variação ano a ano.

segments.src: Analysts often compare the actual numbers with the consensus forecast, since a surprise in either direction can move markets.
segments.tr: Os analistas costumam comparar os números reais com a previsão de consenso, já que uma surpresa em qualquer direção pode movimentar os mercados.

segments.src: ## Why the Fed Pays Close Attention
segments.tr: ## Por Que o Fed Presta Muita Atenção

segments.src: The Federal Reserve has a dual mandate: stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: O Federal Reserve tem um mandato duplo: preços estáveis e emprego máximo.

segments.src: When it sets its benchmark interest rate, it weighs inflation data against labor market conditions.
segments.tr: Quando define sua taxa básica de juros, ele pondera os dados de inflação em relação às condições do mercado de trabalho.

segments.src: - If inflation cools in line with or faster than expected, policymakers may feel more comfortable easing policy.
segments.tr: - Se a inflação desacelerar em linha com o esperado ou mais rápido do que o previsto, os formuladores de políticas podem se sentir mais confortáveis em afrouxar a política monetária.

segments.src: - If inflation proves stubborn, the Fed may hold rates steady for longer, and some investors may reduce their expectations for rate cuts.
segments.tr: - Se a inflação se mostrar persistente, o Fed pode manter as taxas estáveis por mais tempo, e alguns investidores podem reduzir suas expectativas para cortes de juros.

segments.src: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge is actually the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, but CPI arrives earlier and is widely used as a signal for what PCE may show.
segments.tr: O indicador de inflação preferido do Fed é, na verdade, o índice de preços de Despesas de Consumo Pessoal (PCE), mas o IPC chega antes e é amplamente utilizado como um sinal do que o PCE pode mostrar.

segments.src: That is why a single CPI release can carry so much weight.
segments.tr: É por isso que um único relatório do IPC pode ter tanto peso.

segments.src: ## The Rate Backdrop: Yields and Borrowing Costs
segments.tr: ## O Cenário das Taxas: Rendimentos e Custos de Empréstimo

segments.src: Longer-term Treasury yields influence borrowing costs across the economy, including mortgage rates, auto loans and business financing.
segments.tr: Os rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro de longo prazo influenciam os custos de empréstimos em toda a economia, incluindo taxas de financiamento imobiliário, empréstimos automotivos e financiamentos empresariais.

segments.src: When yields rise, those costs often move up as well, even if the Fed has not changed its own policy rate.
segments.tr: Quando os rendimentos sobem, esses custos frequentemente também sobem, mesmo que o Fed não tenha alterado sua própria taxa básica de juros.

segments.src: Because yields reflect expectations about future inflation and future Fed decisions, a CPI report that changes those expectations can ripple quickly through bond markets.
segments.tr: Como os rendimentos refletem as expectativas sobre a inflação futura e as decisões futuras do Fed, um relatório do IPC que mude essas expectativas pode se propagar rapidamente pelos mercados de títulos.

segments.src: For households, that can mean changes in what it costs to finance a home, a car or a large purchase.
segments.tr: Para as famílias, isso pode significar mudanças no custo para financiar uma casa, um carro ou uma grande compra.

segments.src: ## Category One: Shelter
segments.tr: ## Categoria Um: Moradia (Shelter)

segments.src: Shelter, which includes rent and owners' equivalent rent, is the largest single component of the CPI.
segments.tr: A moradia, que inclui aluguel e o aluguel equivalente ao do proprietário, é o maior componente individual do IPC.

segments.src: Because it carries so much weight, even small monthly changes can have a noticeable effect on the overall number.
segments.tr: Como possui tanto peso, até mesmo pequenas variações mensais podem ter um efeito perceptível no número geral.

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: O que observar:

segments.src: - **Rent and owners' equivalent rent.** These measures often move gradually, since they reflect leases that renew over time. A steady cooling trend would be a welcome sign for inflation watchers.
segments.tr: - **Aluguel e aluguel equivalente ao do proprietário.** Essas medidas geralmente mudam gradualmente, pois refletem contratos de aluguel que são renovados ao longo do tempo. Uma tendência constante de desaceleração seria um sinal bem-vindo para os observadores da inflação.

segments.src: - **Lodging away from home.** Hotel prices can be volatile and may add noise to the monthly figure.
segments.tr: - **Hospedagem fora de casa.** Os preços dos hotéis podem ser voláteis e adicionar ruído à figura mensal.

segments.src: **Household impact:** For renters, shelter costs are often the biggest line in the budget.
segments.tr: **Impacto nas famílias:** Para os inquilinos, os custos de moradia costumam ser a maior linha do orçamento.

segments.src: Lease renewals, rather than the monthly CPI release, are usually what change your actual rent, but the broader trend can signal what to expect.
segments.tr: As renovações de contratos, e não o relatório mensal do IPC, costumam ser o que realmente altera o seu aluguel, mas a tendência mais ampla pode sinalizar o que esperar.

segments.src: ## Category Two: Food
segments.tr: ## Categoria Dois: Alimentação

segments.src: Food prices are divided into two parts:
segments.tr: Os preços dos alimentos são divididos em duas partes:

segments.src: - **Food at home**, meaning groceries.
segments.tr: - **Alimentação no domicílio**, ou seja, compras de supermercado.

segments.src: - **Food away from home**, meaning restaurants and takeout.
segments.tr: - **Alimentação fora do domicílio**, ou seja, restaurantes e refeições para viagem.

segments.src: Grocery prices can respond to weather, supply chain conditions, transportation costs and global commodity markets.
segments.tr: Os preços dos produtos de supermercado podem responder ao clima, às condições da cadeia de suprimentos, aos custos de transporte e aos mercados globais de commodities.

segments.src: Restaurant prices tend to be stickier because they reflect labor and rent costs that do not change quickly.
segments.tr: Os preços dos restaurantes tendem a ser mais rígidos porque refletem custos de mão de obra e aluguel que não mudam rapidamente.

segments.src: **Household impact:** Food is a frequent purchase, so price changes are felt quickly.
segments.tr: **Impacto nas famílias:** A alimentação é uma compra frequente, portanto as mudanças de preços são sentidas rapidamente.

segments.src: Many consumers say grocery costs shape their view of the economy more than any headline statistic.
segments.tr: Muitos consumidores afirmam que os custos de supermercado moldam sua visão da economia mais do que qualquer estatística principal.

segments.src: ## Category Three: Energy
segments.tr: ## Categoria Três: Energia

segments.src: Energy includes gasoline, electricity, natural gas and fuel oil.
segments.tr: Energia inclui gasolina, eletricidade, gás natural e óleo combustível.

segments.src: It is typically the most volatile part of the CPI.
segments.tr: É tipicamente a parte mais volátil do IPC.

segments.src: Diesel costs deserve attention because diesel powers trucks, freight and farm equipment, so higher fuel costs can eventually feed into the prices of many goods.
segments.tr: Os custos do diesel merecem atenção porque o diesel movimenta caminhões, fretes e equipamentos agrícolas, de modo que custos mais altos de combustível podem eventualmente se refletir nos preços de muitos bens.

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: O que observar:

segments.src: - **Gasoline.** Often the biggest swing factor in the headline number from month to month.
segments.tr: - **Gasolina.** Frequentemente o maior fator de oscilação no número cheio de mês para mês.

segments.src: - **Utilities.** Electricity and natural gas bills can shift with seasonal demand and fuel costs.
segments.tr: - **Serviços públicos (Utilities).** As contas de eletricidade e gás natural podem mudar de acordo com a demanda sazonal e os custos de combustível.

segments.src: - **Pass-through effects.** Higher transportation costs may show up later in goods prices, which is why analysts look beyond the energy line itself.
segments.tr: - **Efeitos indiretos (Pass-through).** Custos de transporte mais altos podem aparecer mais tarde nos preços dos bens, razão pela qual os analistas olham além da própria linha de energia.

segments.src: **Household impact:** Fuel and utility costs affect commuters, families who drive long distances and anyone with a large heating or cooling bill.
segments.tr: **Impacto nas famílias:** Custos de combustível e serviços públicos afetam motoristas, famílias que dirigem longas distâncias e qualquer pessoa com uma grande conta de aquecimento ou refrigeração.

segments.src: ## Other Areas Worth a Look
segments.tr: ## Outras Áreas que Vale a Pena Observar

segments.src: Beyond the big three, analysts will also check:
segments.tr: Além das três grandes, os analistas também verificarão:

segments.src: - **Core goods**, such as vehicles, furniture and apparel.
segments.tr: - **Núcleo de bens**, como veículos, móveis e vestuário.

segments.src: - **Services excluding shelter**, including insurance, medical care and transportation services, which are closely tied to wages.
segments.tr: - **Serviços exceto moradia**, incluindo seguros, cuidados médicos e serviços de transporte, que estão intimamente ligados aos salários.

segments.src: - **Used vehicle and auto insurance prices**, which have been notable sources of volatility in recent years.
segments.tr: - **Preços de veículos usados e seguros de automóveis**, que têm sido fontes notáveis de volatilidade nos últimos anos.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Report Without Overreacting
segments.tr: ## Como Ler o Relatório Sem Reagir Exageradamente

segments.src: A single month of data rarely tells the full story.
segments.tr: Um único mês de dados raramente conta toda a história.

segments.src: A few habits can help:
segments.tr: Alguns hábitos podem ajudar:

segments.src: 1. **Compare to expectations.** Markets react to surprises, not to the number alone.
segments.tr: 1. **Compare com as expectativas.** Os mercados reagem a surpresas, não apenas ao número isolado.

segments.src: 2. **Look at the trend.** Three- and six-month changes can smooth out one-off swings.
segments.tr: 2. **Olhe para a tendência.** Mudanças de três e seis meses podem suavizar oscilações pontuais.

segments.src: 3. **Separate headline from core.** A jump driven by energy may mean something different than a jump in services.
segments.tr: 3. **Separe o indicador cheio do núcleo.** Um salto impulsionado pela energia pode significar algo diferente de um salto nos serviços.

segments.src: 4. **Remember revisions and seasonal adjustments.** Data can be revised, and seasonal factors can distort individual months.
segments.tr: 4. **Lembre-se das revisões e ajustes sazonais.** Os dados podem ser revisados, e fatores sazonais podem distorcer meses individuais.

segments.src: ## Practical Takeaways for Your Budget
segments.tr: ## Lições Práticas para o Seu Orçamento

segments.src: Whatever the report shows, a few general steps can help you stay prepared:
segments.tr: Independentemente do que o relatório mostre, alguns passos gerais podem ajudá-lo a se manter preparado:

segments.src: - **Review your recurring expenses.** Rent or mortgage, utilities, groceries, transportation and insurance are the categories most affected by price changes.
segments.tr: - **Revise suas despesas recorrentes.** Aluguel ou financiamento imobiliário, serviços públicos, compras de supermercado, transporte e seguros são as categorias mais afetadas pelas mudanças de preços.

segments.src: - **Check variable-rate debt.** Credit cards and some loans can be sensitive to interest rate expectations.
segments.tr: - **Verifique dívidas com taxas variáveis.** Cartões de crédito e alguns empréstimos podem ser sensíveis às expectativas de taxas de juros.

segments.src: - **Compare savings options.** If rates stay higher for longer, savings accounts and certificates of deposit may continue to offer competitive yields, though terms vary by institution.
segments.tr: - **Compare opções de poupança.** Se as taxas se mantiverem mais altas por mais tempo, contas de poupança e certificados de depósito (CDBs) podem continuar a oferecer rendimentos competitivos, embora os termos variem por instituição.

segments.src: - **Build flexibility.** A small cushion for unexpected price increases can make a month-to-month budget easier to manage.
segments.tr: - **Crie flexibilidade.** Uma pequena reserva para aumentos inesperados de preços pode tornar o orçamento mês a mês mais fácil de gerenciar.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## O Quadro Geral

segments.tr: O relatório do IPC de setembro oferecerá novas evidências sobre se a inflação continua a desacelerar ou se está se mostrando mais persistente.

segments.tr: Karena memiliki bobot yang begitu besar, bahkan perubahan bulanan yang kecil dapat memiliki efek yang nyata pada angka keseluruhan.

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: Apa yang perlu diperhatikan:

segments.src: - **Rent and owners' equivalent rent.** These measures often move gradually, since they reflect leases that renew over time. A steady cooling trend would be a welcome sign for inflation watchers.
segments.tr: - **Sewa dan sewa ekuivalen pemilik.** Ukuran-ukuran ini sering bergerak secara bertahap, karena mencerminkan sewa yang diperbarui dari waktu ke waktu. Tren pendinginan yang stabil akan menjadi tanda yang disambut baik bagi pengamat inflasi.

segments.src: - **Lodging away from home.** Hotel prices can be volatile and may add noise to the monthly figure.
segments.tr: - **Penginapan di luar rumah.** Harga hotel bisa fluktuatif dan dapat menambah kebisingan pada angka bulanan.

segments.src: **Household impact:** For renters, shelter costs are often the biggest line in the budget.
segments.tr: **Dampak rumah tangga:** Bagi penyewa, biaya tempat tinggal sering kali menjadi baris terbesar dalam anggaran.

segments.src: Lease renewals, rather than the monthly CPI release, are usually what change your actual rent, but the broader trend can signal what to expect.
segments.tr: Pembaruan sewa, daripada rilis CPI bulanan, biasanya adalah apa yang mengubah sewa Anda yang sebenarnya, tetapi tren yang lebih luas dapat memberi sinyal apa yang diharapkan.

segments.src: ## Category Two: Food
segments.tr: ## Kategori Dua: Makanan

segments.src: Food prices are divided into two parts:
segments.tr: Harga makanan dibagi menjadi dua bagian:

segments.src: - **Food at home**, meaning groceries.
segments.tr: - **Makanan di rumah**, yang berarti bahan makanan.

segments.src: - **Food away from home**, meaning restaurants and takeout.
segments.tr: - **Makanan di luar rumah**, yang berarti restoran dan makanan dibawa pulang.

segments.src: Grocery prices can respond to weather, supply chain conditions, transportation costs and global commodity markets.
segments.tr: Harga bahan makanan dapat merespons cuaca, kondisi rantai pasokan, biaya transportasi, dan pasar komoditas global.

segments.src: Restaurant prices tend to be stickier because they reflect labor and rent costs that do not change quickly.
segments.tr: Harga restoran cenderung lebih kaku karena mencerminkan biaya tenaga kerja dan sewa yang tidak berubah dengan cepat.

segments.src: **Household impact:** Food is a frequent purchase, so price changes are felt quickly.
segments.tr: **Dampak rumah tangga:** Makanan adalah pembelian yang sering dilakukan, sehingga perubahan harga dirasakan dengan cepat.

segments.src: Many consumers say grocery costs shape their view of the economy more than any headline statistic.
segments.tr: Banyak konsumen mengatakan biaya bahan makanan membentuk pandangan mereka tentang ekonomi lebih dari statistik utama mana pun.

segments.src: ## Category Three: Energy
segments.tr: ## Kategori Tiga: Energi

segments.src: Energy includes gasoline, electricity, natural gas and fuel oil.
segments.tr: Energi mencakup bensin, listrik, gas alam, dan minyak bahan bakar.

segments.src: It is typically the most volatile part of the CPI.
segments.tr: Ini biasanya merupakan bagian yang paling fluktuatif dari CPI.

segments.src: Diesel costs deserve attention because diesel powers trucks, freight and farm equipment, so higher fuel costs can eventually feed into the prices of many goods.
segments.tr: Biaya diesel perlu diperhatikan karena diesel menggerakkan truk, angkutan barang, dan peralatan pertanian, sehingga biaya bahan bakar yang lebih tinggi pada akhirnya dapat masuk ke harga banyak barang.

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: Apa yang perlu diperhatikan:

segments.src: - **Gasoline.** Often the biggest swing factor in the headline number from month to month.
segments.tr: - **Bensin.** Seringkali menjadi faktor ayunan terbesar dalam angka utama dari bulan ke bulan.

segments.src: - **Utilities.** Electricity and natural gas bills can shift with seasonal demand and fuel costs.
segments.tr: - **Utilitas.** Tagihan listrik dan gas alam dapat bergeser dengan permintaan musiman dan biaya bahan bakar.

segments.src: - **Pass-through effects.** Higher transportation costs may show up later in goods prices, which is why analysts look beyond the energy line itself.
segments.tr: - **Efek penularan.** Biaya transportasi yang lebih tinggi mungkin muncul kemudian dalam harga barang, itulah sebabnya analis melihat melampaui lini energi itu sendiri.

segments.src: **Household impact:** Fuel and utility costs affect commuters, families who drive long distances and anyone with a large heating or cooling bill.
segments.tr: **Dampak rumah tangga:** Biaya bahan bakar dan utilitas memengaruhi komuter, keluarga yang mengemudi jarak jauh, dan siapa pun dengan tagihan pemanas atau pendingin yang besar.

segments.src: ## Other Areas Worth a Look
segments.tr: ## Area Lain yang Layak Dilihat

segments.src: Beyond the big three, analysts will also check:
segments.tr: Di luar tiga besar, analis juga akan memeriksa:

segments.src: - **Core goods**, such as vehicles, furniture and apparel.
segments.tr: - **Barang inti**, seperti kendaraan, furnitur, dan pakaian.

segments.src: - **Services excluding shelter**, including insurance, medical care and transportation services, which are closely tied to wages.
segments.tr: - **Jasa tidak termasuk tempat tinggal**, termasuk asuransi, perawatan medis, dan layanan transportasi, yang terkait erat dengan upah.

segments.src: - **Used vehicle and auto insurance prices**, which have been notable sources of volatility in recent years.
segments.tr: - **Harga kendaraan bekas dan asuransi mobil**, yang telah menjadi sumber volatilitas yang menonjol dalam beberapa tahun terakhir.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Report Without Overreacting
segments.tr: ## Cara Membaca Laporan Tanpa Bereaksi Berlebihan

segments.src: A single month of data rarely tells the full story.
segments.tr: Satu bulan data jarang menceritakan keseluruhan cerita.

segments.src: A few habits can help:
segments.tr: Beberapa kebiasaan dapat membantu:

segments.src: 1. **Compare to expectations.** Markets react to surprises, not to the number alone.
segments.tr: 1. **Bandingkan dengan ekspektasi.** Pasar bereaksi terhadap kejutan, bukan terhadap angka itu sendiri.

segments.src: 2. **Look at the trend.** Three- and six-month changes can smooth out one-off swings.
segments.tr: 2. **Lihat trennya.** Perubahan tiga dan enam bulan dapat menghaluskan ayunan satu kali.

segments.src: 3. **Separate headline from core.** A jump driven by energy may mean something different than a jump in services.
segments.tr: 3. **Pisahkan headline dari inti.** Lonjakan yang didorong oleh energi mungkin berarti sesuatu yang berbeda dari lonjakan dalam layanan.

segments.src: 4. **Remember revisions and seasonal adjustments.** Data can be revised, and seasonal factors can distort individual months.
segments.tr: 4. **Ingat revisi dan penyesuaian musiman.** Data dapat direvisi, dan faktor musiman dapat mendistorsi bulan-bulan tertentu.

segments.src: ## Practical Takeaways for Your Budget
segments.tr: ## Takeaway Praktis untuk Anggaran Anda

segments.src: Whatever the report shows, a few general steps can help you stay prepared:
segments.tr: Apa pun yang ditunjukkan laporan tersebut, beberapa langkah umum dapat membantu Anda tetap siap:

segments.src: - **Review your recurring expenses.** Rent or mortgage, utilities, groceries, transportation and insurance are the categories most affected by price changes.
segments.tr: - **Tinjau pengeluaran rutin Anda.** Sewa atau hipotek, utilitas, bahan makanan, transportasi, dan asuransi adalah kategori yang paling terpengaruh oleh perubahan harga.

segments.src: - **Check variable-rate debt.** Credit cards and some loans can be sensitive to interest rate expectations.
segments.tr: - **Periksa utang suku bunga variabel.** Kartu kredit dan beberapa pinjaman bisa sensitif terhadap ekspektasi suku bunga.

segments.src: - **Compare savings options.** If rates stay higher for longer, savings accounts and certificates of deposit may continue to offer competitive yields, though terms vary by institution.
segments.tr: - **Bandingkan opsi tabungan.** Jika suku bunga tetap lebih tinggi lebih lama, rekening tabungan dan sertifikat deposito mungkin terus menawarkan imbal hasil yang kompetitif, meskipun ketentuannya bervariasi menurut institusi.

segments.src: - **Build flexibility.** A small cushion for unexpected price increases can make a month-to-month budget easier to manage.
segments.tr: - **Bangun fleksibilitas.** Bantalan kecil untuk kenaikan harga yang tidak terduga dapat membuat anggaran dari bulan ke bulan lebih mudah dikelola.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: The September CPI report will offer fresh evidence on whether inflation is continuing to cool or proving more persistent.
segments.tr: Laporan CPI September akan menawarkan bukti baru tentang apakah inflasi terus mendingin atau terbukti lebih persisten.

segments.src: Shelter, food and energy are the categories most likely to shape both the headline number and the way households experience prices day to day.
segments.tr: Tempat tinggal, makanan, dan energi adalah kategori yang paling mungkin membentuk angka utama dan cara rumah tangga mengalami harga dari hari ke hari.

segments.src: The reading could influence expectations for the Fed's next move, but the central bank will also weigh employment data and other indicators before making a decision.
segments.tr: Angka tersebut dapat memengaruhi ekspektasi untuk langkah The Fed berikutnya, tetapi bank sentral juga akan menimbang data ketenagakerjaan dan indikator lainnya sebelum membuat keputusan.

segments.src: For the latest figures, consult the Bureau of Labor Statistics at bls.gov and the Federal Reserve at federalreserve.gov.
segments.tr: Untuk angka terbaru, konsultasikan dengan Biro Statistik Tenaga Kerja di bls.gov dan Federal Reserve di federalreserve.gov.

ja.title: 9月CPIレポートを控えて：住居費、食品、エネルギー価格の注目ポイント

segments.src: The next Consumer Price Index (CPI) report is one of the most closely followed economic releases of the year.
segments.tr: 次回発表される消費者物価指数（CPI）レポートは、今年最も注目されている経済指標の一つです。

segments.src: With energy costs in focus, longer-term Treasury yields elevated and the Federal Reserve's next policy meeting approaching, the September reading could shape how markets and households think about interest rates in the months ahead.
segments.tr: エネルギーコストが注目され、長期国債利回りが高止まりし、連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）の次回政策決定会合が近づく中、9月の数値は今後数ヶ月間の市場や家計の金利に対する見方に影響を与える可能性があります。

segments.src: This guide explains what the report measures, which categories deserve the closest attention, and how price changes can show up in a typical household budget.
segments.tr: 本ガイドでは、このレポートが何を測定しているのか、どのカテゴリーに最も注目すべきか、そして価格の変動が一般的な家計の予算にどのように現れるかを解説します。

segments.src: It is general educational information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: これは一般的な教育情報であり、財務上のアドバイスではありません。

segments.src: ## What the CPI Actually Measures
segments.tr: ## CPIが実際に測定しているもの

segments.src: The CPI, published by the U.S.
segments.tr: 米国労働統計局（BLS）が発表するCPIは、

segments.src: Bureau of Labor Statistics, tracks how the prices of a broad basket of goods and services change over time.
segments.tr: 広範な商品やサービスのバスケット（買い物かご）の価格が時間の経過とともにどのように変化するかを追跡します。

segments.src: That basket includes housing, food, transportation, medical care, apparel, recreation and more.
segments.tr: そのバスケットには、住居費、食品、交通費、医療費、衣料品、娯楽などが含まれます。

segments.src: Two versions get the most attention:
segments.tr: 特に注目されるのは以下の2つのバージョンです。

segments.src: - **Headline CPI** covers all items, including food and energy.
segments.tr: - **総合CPI（Headline CPI）**：食品やエネルギーを含むすべての項目をカバーします。

segments.src: - **Core CPI** excludes food and energy, which tend to swing from month to month. Many economists use it as a cleaner read on underlying inflation trends.
segments.tr: - **コアCPI（Core CPI）**：月ごとに変動しやすい食品とエネルギーを除外します。多くのエコノミストは、これを基調的なインフレトレンドをより明確に把握するための指標として利用しています。

segments.src: Both are reported as a monthly change and as a year-over-year change.
segments.tr: どちらも前月比および前年同月比の変化率として報告されます。

segments.src: Analysts often compare the actual numbers with the consensus forecast, since a surprise in either direction can move markets.
segments.tr: どちらの方向へのサプライズであっても市場を動かす可能性があるため、アナリストはしばしば実際の数値をコンセンサス予想と比較します。

segments.src: ## Why the Fed Pays Close Attention
segments.tr: ## FRBが細心の注意を払う理由

segments.src: The Federal Reserve has a dual mandate: stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: 連邦準備制度（Fed）は、物価の安定と雇用の最大化という2つの使命（デュアル・マンデート）を担っています。

segments.src: When it sets its benchmark interest rate, it weighs inflation data against labor market conditions.
segments.tr: 基準金利を設定する際、FRBはインフレデータと労働市場の状況を天秤にかけます。

segments.src: - If inflation cools in line with or faster than expected, policymakers may feel more comfortable easing policy.
segments.tr: - インフレが予想通り、あるいは予想以上に沈静化すれば、政策立案者は政策緩和を進めやすくなるかもしれません。

segments.src: - If inflation proves stubborn, the Fed may hold rates steady for longer, and some investors may reduce their expectations for rate cuts.
segments.tr: - インフレが高止まりする場合、FRBは金利をより長く据え置く可能性があり、一部の投資家は利下げへの期待を後退させるかもしれません。

segments.src: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge is actually the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, but CPI arrives earlier and is widely used as a signal for what PCE may show.
segments.tr: FRBが好むインフレ指標は、実際には個人消費支出（PCE）価格指数ですが、CPIはそれよりも早く発表され、PCEがどのような数値を示すかのシグナルとして広く利用されています。

segments.src: That is why a single CPI release can carry so much weight.
segments.tr: そのため、1回のCPI発表がこれほど大きな意味を持つのです。

segments.src: ## The Rate Backdrop: Yields and Borrowing Costs
segments.tr: ## 金利の背景：利回りと借入コスト

segments.src: Longer-term Treasury yields influence borrowing costs across the economy, including mortgage rates, auto loans and business financing.
segments.tr: 長期国債利回りは、住宅ローン金利、自動車ローン、企業融資など、経済全体の借入コストに影響を与えます。

segments.src: When yields rise, those costs often move up as well, even if the Fed has not changed its own policy rate.
segments.tr: 利回りが上昇すると、FRBが独自の政策金利を変更していなくても、それらのコストも上昇することがよくあります。

segments.src: Because yields reflect expectations about future inflation and future Fed decisions, a CPI report that changes those expectations can ripple quickly through bond markets.
segments.tr: 利回りは将来のインフレや将来のFRBの決定に対する期待を反映するため、その期待を変化させるCPIレポートは債券市場に素早く波及します。

segments.src: For households, that can mean changes in what it costs to finance a home, a car or a large purchase.
segments.tr: 家計にとっては、住宅、自動車、または高額な買い物の資金調達コストの変化を意味する場合があります。

segments.src: ## Category One: Shelter
segments.tr: ## カテゴリー1：住居費

segments.src: Shelter, which includes rent and owners' equivalent rent, is the largest single component of the CPI.
segments.tr: 家賃や帰属家賃（持ち家を借家とみなした場合の家賃評価額）を含む住居費は、CPIの中で最大の単一構成要素です。

segments.src: Because it carries so much weight, even small monthly changes can have a noticeable effect on the overall number.
segments.tr: 非常に大きなウェイトを占めているため、月ごとのわずかな変化であっても、全体の数値に顕著な影響を与える可能性があります。

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: 注目ポイント：

segments.src: - **Rent and owners' equivalent rent.** These measures often move gradually, since they reflect leases that renew over time. A steady cooling trend would be a welcome sign for inflation watchers.
segments.tr: - **家賃と帰属家賃。** これらの指標は、時間の経過とともに更新される賃貸契約を反映するため、通常は緩やかに推移します。着実な沈静化傾向が見られれば、インフレウォッチャーにとっては歓迎すべき兆候となります。

segments.src: - **Lodging away from home.** Hotel prices can be volatile and may add noise to the monthly figure.
segments.tr: - **宿泊費（外出先での宿泊）。** ホテル価格は変動しやすく、月次の数値にノイズを加える可能性があります。

segments.src: **Household impact:** For renters, shelter costs are often the biggest line in the budget.
segments.tr: **家計への影響：** 賃貸派にとって、住居費は家計の中で最大の支出項目であることがよくあります。

segments.src: Lease renewals, rather than the monthly CPI release, are usually what change your actual rent, but the broader trend can signal what to expect.
segments.tr: 実際の家賃が変わるのは、毎月のCPI発表ではなく、通常は契約更新時ですが、より広いトレンドから今後の見通しを予測することができます。

segments.src: ## Category Two: Food
segments.tr: ## カテゴリー2：食品

segments.src: Food prices are divided into two parts:
segments.tr: 食品価格は2つの部分に分かれています。

segments.src: - **Food at home**, meaning groceries.
segments.tr: - **家庭用食品**（食料品）。

segments.src: - **Food away from home**, meaning restaurants and takeout.
segments.tr: - **外食**（レストランやテイクアウト）。

segments.src: Grocery prices can respond to weather, supply chain conditions, transportation costs and global commodity markets.
segments.tr: 食料品価格は、天候、サプライチェーンの状況、輸送コスト、世界のコモディティ市場に反応する可能性があります。

segments.src: Restaurant prices tend to be stickier because they reflect labor and rent costs that do not change quickly.
segments.tr: レストランの価格は、急には変わらない人件費や家賃を反映するため、より粘着性（変化しにくい性質）がある傾向があります。

segments.src: **Household impact:** Food is a frequent purchase, so price changes are felt quickly.
segments.tr: **家計への影響：** 食品は頻繁に購入するものなので、価格の変化をすぐに実感できます。

segments.src: Many consumers say grocery costs shape their view of the economy more than any headline statistic.
segments.tr: 多くの消費者は、総合的な統計数値よりも、食料品のコストが経済に対する見方を形成していると語っています。

segments.src: ## Category Three: Energy
segments.tr: ## カテゴリー3：エネルギー

segments.src: Energy includes gasoline, electricity, natural gas and fuel oil.
segments.tr: エネルギーには、ガソリン、電気、天然ガス、燃料油が含まれます。

segments.src: It is typically the most volatile part of the CPI.
segments.tr: これは通常、CPIの中で最も変動の激しい部分です。

segments.src: Diesel costs deserve attention because diesel powers trucks, freight and farm equipment, so higher fuel costs can eventually feed into the prices of many goods.
segments.tr: 軽油コストは、トラック、貨物、農業用機器の動力源となるため注目に値し、燃料コストの上昇は最終的に多くの商品の価格に波及する可能性があります。

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: 注目ポイント：

segments.src: - **Gasoline.** Often the biggest swing factor in the headline number from month to month.
segments.tr: - **ガソリン。** 月ごとの総合指数の数値を左右する最大の変動要因となることがよくあります。

segments.src: - **Utilities.** Electricity and natural gas bills can shift with seasonal demand and fuel costs.
segments.tr: - **公共料金。** 電気代や天然ガス代は、季節的な需要や燃料コストによって変動する可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Pass-through effects.** Higher transportation costs may show up later in goods prices, which is why analysts look beyond the energy line itself.
segments.tr: - **波及効果（パススルー効果）。** 輸送コストの上昇は後から商品価格に現れる可能性があるため、アナリストはエネルギー項目そのものだけでなく、その先を見据えています。

segments.src: **Household impact:** Fuel and utility costs affect commuters, families who drive long distances and anyone with a large heating or cooling bill.
segments.tr: **家計への影響：** 燃料や公共料金のコストは、通勤・通学者、長距離を運転する家族、そして冷暖房費の負担が大きいすべての人に影響を与えます。

segments.src: ## Other Areas Worth a Look
segments.tr: ## その他の注目すべき分野

segments.src: Beyond the big three, analysts will also check:
segments.tr: 三大カテゴリー以外にも、アナリストは以下をチェックします。

segments.src: - **Core goods**, such as vehicles, furniture and apparel.
segments.tr: - **コア財**（自動車、家具、衣料品など）。

segments.src: - **Services excluding shelter**, including insurance, medical care and transportation services, which are closely tied to wages.
segments.tr: - **住居費を除くサービス**（保険、医療、交通サービスなど、賃金と密接に関連するもの）。

segments.src: - **Used vehicle and auto insurance prices**, which have been notable sources of volatility in recent years.
segments.tr: - **中古車および自動車保険の価格**（近年、顕著な変動要因となっています）。

segments.src: ## How to Read the Report Without Overreacting
segments.tr: ## 過剰反応せずにレポートを読む方法

segments.src: A single month of data rarely tells the full story.
segments.tr: 単一の月のデータだけで全体像を把握できることは滅多にありません。

segments.src: A few habits can help:
segments.tr: 以下のいくつかの習慣が役に立ちます。

segments.src: 1. **Compare to expectations.** Markets react to surprises, not to the number alone.
segments.tr: 1. **予想と比較する。** 市場は数値そのものではなく、サプライズに反応します。

segments.src: 2. **Look at the trend.** Three- and six-month changes can smooth out one-off swings.
segments.tr: 2. **トレンドを見る。** 3ヶ月および6ヶ月の変化を見ることで、一時的な変動を平滑化できます。

segments.src: 3. **Separate headline from core.** A jump driven by energy may mean something different than a jump in services.
segments.tr: 3. **総合とコアを分けて考える。** エネルギー主導の上昇は、サービス主導の上昇とは異なる意味を持つ可能性があります。

segments.src: 4. **Remember revisions and seasonal adjustments.** Data can be revised, and seasonal factors can distort individual months.

de.title: VPI-Bericht für September steht bevor: Worauf bei Wohnkosten, Lebensmittel- und Energiepreisen zu achten ist

segments.src: The next Consumer Price Index (CPI) report is one of the most closely followed economic releases of the year.
segments.tr: Der nächste Bericht zum Verbraucherpreisindex (VPI) ist eine der am aufmerksamsten verfolgten Veröffentlichung von Wirtschaftsdaten des Jahres.

segments.src: With energy costs in focus, longer-term Treasury yields elevated and the Federal Reserve's next policy meeting approaching, the September reading could shape how markets and households think about interest rates in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Da die Energiekosten im Fokus stehen, die längerfristigen Renditen von US-Staatsanleihen erhöht sind und die nächste Zinssitzung der Federal Reserve bevorsteht, könnte der Wert für September beeinflussen, wie Märkte und Haushalte in den kommenden Monaten über Zinssätze denken.

segments.src: This guide explains what the report measures, which categories deserve the closest attention, and how price changes can show up in a typical household budget.
segments.tr: Dieser Leitfaden erklärt, was der Bericht misst, welche Kategorien die größte Aufmerksamkeit verdienen und wie sich Preisänderungen in einem typischen Haushaltsbudget niederschlagen können.

segments.src: It is general educational information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: Dies sind allgemeine Bildungsinformationen und keine Finanzberatung.

segments.src: ## What the CPI Actually Measures
segments.tr: ## Was der VPI tatsächlich misst

segments.src: The CPI, published by the U.S.
segments.tr: Der VPI, veröffentlicht vom U.S.

segments.src: Bureau of Labor Statistics, tracks how the prices of a broad basket of goods and services change over time.
segments.tr: Bureau of Labor Statistics, verfolgt, wie sich die Preise eines breiten Warenkorbs von Waren und Dienstleistungen im Laufe der Zeit verändern.

segments.src: That basket includes housing, food, transportation, medical care, apparel, recreation and more.
segments.tr: Dieser Warenkorb umfasst Wohnen, Lebensmittel, Transport, medizinische Versorgung, Bekleidung, Erholung und mehr.

segments.src: Two versions get the most attention:
segments.tr: Zwei Versionen erhalten die meiste Aufmerksamkeit:

segments.src: - **Headline CPI** covers all items, including food and energy.
segments.tr: - **Gesamt-VPI (Headline CPI)** umfasst alle Artikel, einschließlich Lebensmittel und Energie.

segments.src: - **Core CPI** excludes food and energy, which tend to swing from month to month. Many economists use it as a cleaner read on underlying inflation trends.
segments.tr: - **Kern-VPI (Core CPI)** schließt Lebensmittel und Energie aus, die von Monat zu Monat schwanken können. Viele Ökonomen verwenden ihn als klareren Indikator für zugrunde liegende Inflationstrends.

segments.src: Both are reported as a monthly change and as a year-over-year change.
segments.tr: Beide werden als monatliche Veränderung und als Veränderung im Jahresvergleich gemeldet.

segments.src: Analysts often compare the actual numbers with the consensus forecast, since a surprise in either direction can move markets.
segments.tr: Analysten vergleichen die tatsächlichen Zahlen oft mit der Konsensprognose, da eine Überraschung in die eine oder andere Richtung die Märkte bewegen kann.

segments.src: ## Why the Fed Pays Close Attention
segments.tr: ## Warum die Fed genau hinschaut

segments.src: The Federal Reserve has a dual mandate: stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: Die Federal Reserve hat ein duales Mandat: Preisstabilität und maximale Beschäftigung.

segments.src: When it sets its benchmark interest rate, it weighs inflation data against labor market conditions.
segments.tr: Wenn sie ihren Leitzins festlegt, wägt sie Inflationsdaten gegen die Bedingungen am Arbeitsmarkt ab.

segments.src: - If inflation cools in line with or faster than expected, policymakers may feel more comfortable easing policy.
segments.tr: - Wenn sich die Inflation im Einklang mit den Erwartungen oder schneller als erwartet abkühlt, fühlen sich die politischen Entscheidungsträger möglicherweise wohler dabei, die Geldpolitik zu lockern.

segments.src: - If inflation proves stubborn, the Fed may hold rates steady for longer, and some investors may reduce their expectations for rate cuts.
segments.tr: - Wenn sich die Inflation als hartnäckig erweist, hält die Fed die Zinsen möglicherweise länger stabil, und einige Anleger könnten ihre Erwartungen hinsichtlich Zinssenkungen reduzieren.

segments.src: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge is actually the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, but CPI arrives earlier and is widely used as a signal for what PCE may show.
segments.tr: Der von der Fed bevorzugte Inflationsindikator ist eigentlich der Preisindex für die persönlichen Konsumausgaben (PCE), aber der VPI erscheint früher und wird häufig als Signal dafür verwendet, was der PCE zeigen könnte.

segments.src: That is why a single CPI release can carry so much weight.
segments.tr: Aus diesem Grund kann eine einzige VPI-Veröffentlichung so viel Gewicht haben.

segments.src: ## The Rate Backdrop: Yields and Borrowing Costs
segments.tr: ## Der Zins-Hintergrund: Renditen und Kreditkosten

segments.src: Longer-term Treasury yields influence borrowing costs across the economy, including mortgage rates, auto loans and business financing.
segments.tr: Längerfristige Treasury-Renditen beeinflussen die Kreditkosten in der gesamten Wirtschaft, einschließlich Hypothekenzinsen, Autokrediten und Unternehmensfinanzierungen.

segments.src: When yields rise, those costs often move up as well, even if the Fed has not changed its own policy rate.
segments.tr: Wenn die Renditen steigen, steigen diese Kosten oft ebenfalls, selbst wenn die Fed ihren eigenen Leitzins nicht geändert hat.

segments.src: Because yields reflect expectations about future inflation and future Fed decisions, a CPI report that changes those expectations can ripple quickly through bond markets.
segments.tr: Da Renditen Erwartungen über zukünftige Inflation und zukünftige Entscheidungen der Fed widerspiegeln, kann ein VPI-Bericht, der diese Erwartungen ändert, schnell durch die Anleihenmärkte hallen.

segments.src: For households, that can mean changes in what it costs to finance a home, a car or a large purchase.
segments.tr: Für Haushalte kann das bedeuten, dass sich die Kosten für die Finanzierung eines Hauses, eines Autos oder eines großen Kaufs ändern.

segments.src: ## Category One: Shelter
segments.tr: ## Kategorie Eins: Wohnen (Shelter)

segments.src: Shelter, which includes rent and owners' equivalent rent, is the largest single component of the CPI.
segments.tr: Wohnen, was Miete und den Mietwert für selbstgenutztes Wohneigentum (Owners' Equivalent Rent) umfasst, ist die größte Einzelkomponente des VPI.

segments.src: Because it carries so much weight, even small monthly changes can have a noticeable effect on the overall number.
segments.tr: Da es so viel Gewicht hat, können selbst kleine monatliche Änderungen einen spürbaren Effekt auf die Gesamtzahl haben.

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: Worauf zu achten ist:

segments.src: - **Rent and owners' equivalent rent.** These measures often move gradually, since they reflect leases that renew over time. A steady cooling trend would be a welcome sign for inflation watchers.
segments.tr: - **Miete und Mietwert für selbstgenutztes Wohneigentum.** Diese Kennzahlen bewegen sich oft schrittweise, da sie Mietverträge widerspiegeln, die im Laufe der Zeit erneuert werden. Ein stetiger Abkühlungstrend wäre ein willkommenes Zeichen für Inflationsbeobachter.

segments.src: - **Lodging away from home.** Hotel prices can be volatile and may add noise to the monthly figure.
segments.tr: - **Unterkünfte außerhalb des Hauses.** Hotelpreise können volatil sein und dem Monats Wert Rauschen hinzufügen.

segments.src: **Household impact:** For renters, shelter costs are often the biggest line in the budget.
segments.tr: **Auswirkungen auf den Haushalt:** Für Mieter sind die Wohnkosten oft der größte Posten im Budget.

segments.src: Lease renewals, rather than the monthly CPI release, are usually what change your actual rent, but the broader trend can signal what to expect.
segments.tr: Mietvertragsverlängerungen und nicht die monatliche VPI-Veröffentlichung sind normalerweise das, was Ihre tatsächliche Miete ändert, aber der breitere Trend kann signalisieren, was zu erwarten ist.

segments.src: ## Category Two: Food
segments.tr: ## Kategorie Zwei: Lebensmittel

segments.src: Food prices are divided into two parts:
segments.tr: Lebensmittelpreise sind in zwei Teile unterteilt:

segments.src: - **Food at home**, meaning groceries.
segments.tr: - **Lebensmittel zu Hause**, gemeint sind Lebensmittelgeschäfte/Supermärkte.

segments.src: - **Food away from home**, meaning restaurants and takeout.
segments.tr: - **Lebensmittel außer Haus**, gemeint sind Restaurants und Abholessen.

segments.src: Grocery prices can respond to weather, supply chain conditions, transportation costs and global commodity markets.
segments.tr: Die Preise im Lebensmittelgeschäft können auf Wetter, Lieferkettenbedingungen, Transportkosten und globale Rohstoffmärkte reagieren.

segments.src: Restaurant prices tend to be stickier because they reflect labor and rent costs that do not change quickly.
segments.tr: Restaurantpreise neigen dazu, träger zu sein, da sie Arbeits- und Mietkosten widerspiegeln, die sich nicht schnell ändern.

segments.src: **Household impact:** Food is a frequent purchase, so price changes are felt quickly.
segments.tr: **Auswirkungen auf den Haushalt:** Lebensmittel sind ein häufiger Kauf, daher werden Preisänderungen schnell gespürt.

segments.src: Many consumers say grocery costs shape their view of the economy more than any headline statistic.
segments.tr: Viele Verbraucher sagen, dass die Kosten für Lebensmittel ihre Sicht auf die Wirtschaft mehr prägen als jede Schlagzeilen-Statistik.

segments.src: ## Category Three: Energy
segments.tr: ## Kategorie Drei: Energie

segments.src: Energy includes gasoline, electricity, natural gas and fuel oil.
segments.tr: Energie umfasst Benzin, Elektrizität, Erdgas und Heizöl.

segments.src: It is typically the most volatile part of the CPI.
segments.tr: Es ist typischerweise der volatilste Teil des VPI.

segments.src: Diesel costs deserve attention because diesel powers trucks, freight and farm equipment, so higher fuel costs can eventually feed into the prices of many goods.
segments.tr: Diesel kosten verdienen Aufmerksamkeit, weil Diesel LKWs, Fracht und Landwirtschaftsgeräte antreibt, so dass höhere Treibstoffkosten schließlich in die Preise vieler Güter einfließen können.

segments.src: What to watch:
segments.tr: Worauf zu achten ist:

segments.src: - **Gasoline.** Often the biggest swing factor in the headline number from month to month.
segments.tr: - **Benzin.** Oft der größte Schwankungsfaktor in der Gesamtzahl von Monat zu Monat.

segments.src: - **Utilities.** Electricity and natural gas bills can shift with seasonal demand and fuel costs.
segments.tr: - **Versorgungsunternehmen.** Strom- und Erdgaskosten können sich mit saisonaler Nachfrage und Treibstoffkosten verschieben.

segments.src: - **Pass-through effects.** Higher transportation costs may show up later in goods prices, which is why analysts look beyond the energy line itself.
segments.tr: - **Durchreiche-Effekte.** Höhere Transportkosten können später in den Warenpreisen auftauchen, weshalb Analysten über die Energielinie hinausblicken.

segments.src: **Household impact:** Fuel and utility costs affect commuters, families who drive long distances and anyone with a large heating or cooling bill.
segments.tr: **Auswirkungen auf den Haushalt:** Treibstoff- und Versorgungskosten betreffen Pendler, Familien, die lange Strecken fahren, und jeden mit einer großen Heiz- oder Kühlrechnung.

segments.src: ## Other Areas Worth a Look
segments.tr: ## Andere Bereiche, die einen Blick wert sind

segments.src: Beyond the big three, analysts will also check:
segments.tr: Über die großen drei hinaus werden Analysten auch prüfen:

segments.src: - **Core goods**, such as vehicles, furniture and apparel.
segments.tr: - **Kerngüter**, wie Fahrzeuge, Möbel und Bekleidung.

segments.src: - **Services excluding shelter**, including insurance, medical care and transportation services, which are closely tied to wages.
segments.tr: - **Dienstleistungen ohne Wohnen**, einschließlich Versicherung, medizinische Versorgung und Transportdienstleistungen, die eng mit Löhnen verknüpft sind.

segments.src: - **Used vehicle and auto insurance prices**, which have been notable sources of volatility in recent years.
segments.tr: - **Gebrauchtwagen- und Autoversicherungs Preise**, die in den letzten Jahren bemerkenswerte Quellen der Volatilität waren.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Report Without Overreacting
segments.tr: ## Wie man den Bericht liest, ohne überzuagieren

segments.src: A single month of data rarely tells the full story.
segments.tr: Ein einziger Monat an Daten erzählt selten die ganze Geschichte.

segments.src: A few habits can help:
segments.tr: Ein paar Gewohnheiten können helfen:

segments.src: 1. **Compare to expectations.** Markets react to surprises, not to the number alone.
segments.tr: 1. **Mit Erwartungen vergleichen.** Märkte reagieren auf Überraschungen, nicht nur auf die Zahl allein.

segments.src: 2. **Look at the trend.** Three- and six-month changes can smooth out one-off swings.
segments.tr: 2. **Den Trend betrachten.** Drei- und Sechsmonatsänderungen können einmalige Schwankungen glätten.

segments.src: 3. **Separate headline from core.** A jump driven by energy may mean something different than a jump in services.
segments.tr: 3. **Gesamt von Kern trennen.** Ein durch Energie angetriebener Sprung kann etwas anderes bedeuten als ein Sprung bei Dienstleistungen.

segments.src: 4. **Remember revisions and seasonal adjustments.** Data can be revised, and seasonal factors can distort individual months.
segments.tr: 4. **Revisionen und saisonale Anpassungen erinnern.** Daten können revidiert werden, und saisonale Faktoren können einzelne Monate verzerren.

segments.src: ## Practical Takeaways for Your Budget
segments.tr: ## Praktische Erkenntnisse für Ihr Budget

segments.src: Whatever the report shows, a few general steps can help you stay prepared:
segments.tr: Unabhängig davon, was der Bericht zeigt, können ein paar allgemeine Schritte helfen, vorbereitet zu bleiben:

segments.src: - **Review your recurring expenses.** Rent or mortgage, utilities, groceries, transportation and insurance are the categories most affected by price changes.
segments.tr: - **Überprüfen Sie Ihre wiederkehrenden Ausgaben.** Miete oder Hypothek, Versorgungsunternehmen, Lebensmittel, Transport und Versicherung sind die Kategorien, die am stärksten von Preisänderungen betroffen sind.

segments.src: - **Check variable-rate debt.** Credit cards and some loans can be sensitive to interest rate expectations.
segments.tr: - **Überprüfen Sie variabel verzinsliche Schulden.** Kreditkarten und einige Kredite können empfindlich auf Zinserwartungen reagieren.

segments.src: - **Compare savings options.** If rates stay higher for longer, savings accounts and certificates of deposit may continue to offer competitive yields, though terms vary by institution.

segments.src: - **Build flexibility.** A small cushion for unexpected price increases can make a month-to-month budget easier to manage.
segments.tr: - **Flexibilität aufbauen.** Ein kleiner Puffer für unerwartete Preiserhöhungen kann ein Monatsbudget einfacher zu verwalten machen.
